edus.text: I invite Mr. Khoo Poay Tiong, Melaka City.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong ask the Minister of Communications and Digital to state the explanation of the new Mandatory Standard on Access Pricing (MSAP)
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: which came into effect in March 2023,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and what the impact will be on the telecommunications sector and users in Malaysia in terms of service quality.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: The mandatory standard regarding access prices, with permission, Mandatory Standard on Access Pricing (MSAP) is one of the legal instruments issued by the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (SKMM)
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: to regulate access prices at the wholesale level or, with permission, wholesale to provide access services.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Through the new MSAP
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: which came into effect on March 1, 2023, the maximum access price has been set for 14 facilities and services listed for a period up to 2025.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: With the implementation of the new MSAP, access service providers need to provide facilities
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and services listed at a new maximum price to access service recipients as set by SKMM.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: A public investigation paper on MSAP was issued by SKMM on October 5, 2022 until January 17, 2023 to get recommendations and feedback from industry players and the public regarding the MSAP implementation method to be made.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: A total of 16 feedback has been received from relevant stakeholders
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: including Celcom, Digi, Telekom Malaysia Berhad and Digital National Berhad.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: All of these feedback have been studied
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and considered by SKMM in determining the MSAP implementation method.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In general, the price set in the new MSAP is lower compared to the previous MSAP.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For example, the price for high-speed broadband wholesale services or, with permission, high speed broadband for 100 Mbps speed in the new MSAP for the year 2023 is RM254.64 per month
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: compared to the price of RM515 per month before.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Therefore, it can reduce the cost to access service recipients involved in providing fixed broadband services to users.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Indirectly, services provided to consumers at the retail or retail level can be offered at a lower and competitive price or at a higher speed.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In terms of service quality, SKMM uses other instruments to regulate, including through the Mandatory Standard Quality of Service (MSQoS)
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and the implementation of periodic audits against service provider companies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Honrable Kota Melaka.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, my additional question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: First of all, I would like to congratulate the Honorable Minister
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and also the ministry
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: that has implemented this new MSAP.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: It is certain that it will bring benefits to consumers and due to the increase in competition between companies that provide internet services.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: We still remember in 2018,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: when Pakatan Harapan became the government, the former Minister, the Honorable Damansara, implemented, `` half the price doubles the speed ''.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So, today we are heading in another direction.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: This shows a Madani Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I want to ask the Honorable Minister about Telekom Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: When this MSAP announcement is announced, we can see the reaction from the stock market where the price of the Honorable Deputy Minister has dropped
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: because they say, with the decrease in wholesale costs, this will affect the performance of the Honorable Deputy Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I would like to ask the Honorable Minister,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: what is the long-term impact of the implementation of this new MSAP on telecommunication companies, especially those who have invested a lot to provide fiber infrastructure.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So, how will this affect them
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and what is the long-term impact for us to ensure, we can achieve our target to move towards digitalized this.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kota Melaka,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Regarding the question raised earlier, specifically the figures or information I have, specifically about Telekom Malaysia,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I have held a series of meetings with the top management including the Board of Directors from Telekom Malaysia and indeed, if we look, we make a comparison from 2017 to today, in 2017 as a group - as a group, with permission, net profit in 2017 for TM which is RM730.5 million.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In 2018, after starting MSAP at that time was implemented, indeed in terms of profit, they saw a negative profit or a loss of RM260.5 million.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: However, with permission, they were able to bounce back a year after that by recording net profit in 2019 of RM557.4 million and the trend continued to increase until last February 28 where the announcement from the management of Telekom Malaysia, made an announcement that they had recorded a net profit of RM1.14 billion for last year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So this Mr. Speaker, shows that the spirit of Malaysia can indeed exist in Telekom Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Despite being given a challenge,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: they are able to rise again.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I believe that
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: if Telekom Malaysia can record in the early year a little loss,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: but the benefits to the people and the reality is that they managed to return
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and this for me is an example for us as a country as well.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So God willing,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I believe that although there is an effect,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I understand that so far, from all analysts, the trend is still for TM shares, is still a buy with permission.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I invite the Honorable Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I take the opportunity to express my condolences to flood victims in Johor
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and I believe the government is doing its best to act in Johor, God willing.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister for the answer earlier.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I feel quite proud of the seriousness of the commitment committed by the Honorable Minister to ensure that this MSAP can be implemented well.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: It's just that if we notice that in Malaysia today, I quote a study from a UCLA body carried out by 102 countries, Malaysia is far behind
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: compared to Cambodia and Vietnam.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: We are slower from the internet service perspective.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So when talking about this internet,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: when can the government finalize 5G services that can be implemented covering more than 50 percent, let's say in areas throughout Malaysia?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Also, can the government ensure that these service providers can provide services in places that do not give them profit?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I take the example of my area in Pasir Mas, the population is a little ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Summarize the question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Perhaps it does not provide much profit to service providers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: How far can the government commit coercion?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Pasir Mas,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Although today's question is related to the Mandatory Standard on Access Pricing ( MSAP ), I also answer a specific question related to the quality of internet services.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: He has two types, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: One, whether it's mobile internet or mobile internet or fixed line broadband internet.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For MSAP that we mentioned today, it is more focused on fixed line broadband or highspeed broadband.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: However, for your information, as announced by SKMM
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and also Digital Nasional Berhad, in terms of access for 5G so far for populated areas or coverage of populated areas has reached 50 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Our target by the end of the year, is able to reach 80 percent of populated areas.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: But not so far, it needs to be more than that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This is because for everyone's information, the coverage only refers to whether there is a tower or there
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: is no tower there.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: If in the building for example, in building coverage, that is a benchmark.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: If we are for example Mr. Speaker, in this honorable House, before the presentation of the budget during the day, I have met with the Chief Administrator of Parliament as well as media friends at the media center below
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and they state the internet problem there.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This area has coverage,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: but the issue is access point (AP).
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: So, that's why in God willing, March 6 and 7, namely next Monday and Tuesday, I welcome and invite all Members of Parliament to come
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and bring your problems in their respective areas with the priority of stating the location, what is the problem, who is the person in charge (PIC) that can be contacted by SKMM
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and we will open the counter on those two days.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: God willing, we will deal with the issues raised by the Honorable Members immediately,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: including friends from Sabah, Sarawak
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and also Pasir Mas for sure.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I invite Mr. Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas, Mersing.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: First of all, I take this opportunity to express my condolences to all the families of flood victims in Mersing and thank you to all the officers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas asked the Minister of Higher Education to state
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: following the government's decision not to abolish AUKU as announced recently, will the government continue the practice of appointing vice chancellors by the Minister

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the Ministry of Health Malaysia has introduced an Action Plan to the direction of the Elimination of Serviks Cancer in Malaysia 2021-2030
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: based on the Global Strategy to Accelerate the Elimination of Cervical Cancer as a Public Health Problem developed by the World Health Organization.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Therefore, the Ministry of Health strives to ensure that: ( i ) 90 percent of HPV vaccination coverage for girls
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: before they are 15 years old; ( ii ) 70 percent screening coverage by using the latest methods that are proven to be scientifically effective for women aged 35 and 45 at least twice in life; and ( iii ) 90 percent of positive women get early intervention and treatment for precancers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: This action plan is a framework that includes the goals and targets of elimination by 2030.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: In order to set the direction of this action plan, there are five priorities of the Ministry of Health, namely: ( i ) strengthen governance and policies; ( ii ) enrich access and participation; ( iii ) improve service delivery; ( iv ) foster cooperation between sectors; and ( v ) monitoring, evaluation and research.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Until now there are several achievements of this action plan that have been achieved by the Ministry of Health as follows: ( i ) the formation of the National Serviks Cancer Elimination Program Steering Committee
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: which acts as an advisor to set the direction of the National Serviks Cancer Elimination Program as well as approve policy decisions related to the program carried out; ( ii ) the increase in the level of public health literacy regarding the importance of cervical cancer screening is one of the strategies to increase screening coverage that can be achieved through the development of the Strategic Communications Plan; and ( iii ) ensure that women get access to HPV tests through the expansion of HPV screening tests to all states.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: The Ministry of Health also aims to increase HPV test screening access to PeKa B40 recipients.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Discussions have been held to establish a collaboration with ProtectHealth Corporation Sdn.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Bhd.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: to achieve those aspirations.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: The Serviks Cancer Management Guidelines Committee is currently in the final stage of the review of the Guideline for Cervical Cancer Screening in Malaysia (2nd Edition).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: These guidelines involve the management of pap smear screening and HPV screening tests.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, a little more.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: In order to ensure the competence of health personnel, HPV screening test training is carried out comprehensively to all health staff in each state every year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: The Ministry of Health also collaborates with the Health System Research Institute, conducting research entitled Cervical Cancer Screening: Simulation of Best Practices to Achieve the Target
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: which aims to make cervical cancer screening projections in Malaysia through a simulation model based on HPV screening strategies designed.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Next, place seven colposcope equipment at Sarawak General Hospital, Sibu Hospital, Klang Hospital, Kulim Hospital, Langkawi Hospital, Selayang Hospital and National Cancer Institutes in an effort
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: to increase access to patients who are detected as positive as HPV
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: or found to have abnormal pap smear results.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, currently the Ministry of Health maintains a injection policy only for 13-year-old girls.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: For adult women, the prevention of cervical cancer is through screening either through pap smear or HPV screening tests.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: In addition, women are also given the option to take HPV vaccination at private health facilities where the effects of vaccination depend on age and status of exposure to sexual activity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Fong Kui Lun asked the Prime Minister to state the positive results of His Excellency the Prime Minister's recent visit to China in terms of economy and investment opportunities and what benefits Malaysians will get later.
edus.speaker: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Bukit Bintang.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Alhamdulillah, the visit to China recorded good success.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: I take this opportunity to thank President Xi Jinping; Prime Minister Li Qiang and the Chinese Government [ Applause ] who gave recognition for either giving a keynote opportunity at the Boao Forum in Hainan and also programs arranged in Beijing.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: We also take advantage of such as signing five MoUs between the two governments witnessed by Prime Minister Li Qiang and me.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: This is to increase trade economic cooperation, import and export of agricultural materials, education, aquaculture food and efforts
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: to increase oil palm and oil palm imports.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: We focus for example the assessment of the Belt and Road Initiative programs including Twin Countries, Twin Parks based in Kuantan and ECRL.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: The new development is the addition of the Automotive Hi-Tech Valley Geely and Proton projects starting this year, the addition in Tanjong Malim 1,000 acres with a start of RM2 billion and will reach RM32 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: The world's largest petrochemicals company, Rongsheng has agreed to increase activities in Malaysia by centralizing the petrochemicals oil and gas manufacturing process in Pengerang and they put the project up to RM80 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: The total is RM170.07 billion which is the largest investment ever achieved by the country.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: China also provides better space,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: so the increase in the value of product exports to China is RM2.44 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: The next benefit is a matter of job opportunities and different in past experiences, we have emphasized two additional things.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: First, Geely, Rongsheng stipulates that all job opportunities are focused on the local community.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: All follow-up business opportunities, side in their project circles are also managed by local companies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: They only ask now and we agree on the principle of approving, professionals who do not have the ability in the country.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: In addition, we have proposed and agreed to start with Geely who is the biggest investor now to hold special program training for local children in part in Malaysia, some in their business activities center, their industry in China.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: So, there should be special training for them.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Geely also agreed to start this year and I remember his follow-up action will be held next month where the chairman will be present to establish Malaysia as Geely center for the Asia Pacific region.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: So, this will cause our job opportunities, our children will be much more than expected before.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Okay, I invite the Honorable Bukit Bintang.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.

addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Since it managed to achieve a commitment of RM170 billion, China's report through 19 MoUs that have been signed by both sides of their respective countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I would like to ask Your Honor, will the government set up a special committee to monitor reports from China so that they are easier, smoother and more organized so that investors are more confident in the capabilities of the Malaysian Government?
edus.speaker: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.

addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
