edus.text: The Prime Minister. Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, we will indeed discuss in the Cabinet Meeting tomorrow and follow-up measures, whether there should be a special committee or not, we will also decide tomorrow.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: However, so far this program and this project are monitored by MITI and we have MIDA and MATRADE which I think can maintain
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: because the preparations made by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, MITI and the officials are very satisfactory and cause us to be able to achieve the expected performance.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: I also take this opportunity to mention that in the tour network we also focus on the position of the Muslim community in Beijing and Hainan.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: I was quite impressed when Prime Minister Li Qiang gave the dinner feast in honor of iftar time, waiting until iftar time for the same iftar by the Prime Minister of China, me and the group.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Following that, I believe that these departments will be done and if necessary, the Cabinet will decide tomorrow.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Fong Kui Lun [Bukit Bintang]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Kubang Pasu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, first of all I would like to congratulate the Most Honorable Tambun for the recent visit to China which is considered quite successful according to many media reports, especially in the investment sector which reaches up to RM170 billion.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: A big number.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: My first question is Mr. Speaker, please Mr. Tambun give details in terms of the sectors involved, for example the manufacturing and service industry sector in the MoU signed by Malaysian and Chinese businessmen.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I know, it was mentioned earlier by the Most Honorable Tambun, RM32 billion Geely for Proton and RM80 billion for the chemical and gas industry in Pengerang.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, the remaining RM58 billion.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, Malaysian businessmen, from our experience, it is really enjoyable to sign the MoU in front of the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun inform me of the confidence level, confidence in the MoU amounting to 19 all which will be translated into real investment that can be realized.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I also read the newspaper that one of the reports sectors that will be brought here is green technology and the digital economy.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Honorable Kubang Pasu, the question is very long.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: It's not the time for us to ask the Prime Minister like this.
edus.speaker: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Shorten it, shorten it.
edus.speaker: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Be patient, be patient.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]

edus.text: Okay Honorable Hulu Langat, be patient.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]

edus.text: New friend. It's okay, be patient, be patient.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]

edus.text: Speak like that, it's going to take longer Your Honor Hulu Langat. Such a friend.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, when will the investment expectation be implemented?
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: How many job opportunities will be created from this investment?
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Beautiful question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to ask for a little advice from Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: The Prime Minister wants to answer.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]

edus.text: The Prime Minister wants to answer, okay okay.
edus.speaker: Tuan Mohd Sany bin Hamzan [Hulu Langat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kubang Pasu for the question.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: In fact, the automative field - 3, petrochemical field - 2, glass product building technology field - 2, electrical and electronic - 2, metal - 1, transport equipment - 1 and the focus service field is data center, especially after AWS decided to operate from Malaysia, there are four international data centers, telecommunications - 2, finance - 3, e-commerce - 1.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: One to take advantage of the free trade zone and one in terms of public aviation.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: So, 12 services, 11 manufacturing, nine imports and four infrastructure.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: We are different from the usual MoU. Prime Minister Li Qiang and I decided not to serve the MoU.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: There are nine other proposals that are not accepted
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: because there is no specific planning for implementation from this year or at the end of this year at the latest.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: So what was decided is from the companies that have been decided to be monitored by the Malaysian Government under MITI especially and by the Chinese Government under the supervision of Prime Minister Li Qiang which are the companies that will implement at the end of this year or at the latest next year.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: I mentioned earlier for example two Geely initial companies, which is that I will be present at the beginning of next month and this is confirmed by Proton to implement the program in Tanjong Malim in addition to the existing one.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: This Geely only expands from the original project to EV and others.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: The same goes for Rongsheng who has visited two weeks ago
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: because this is a setting by the Chinese Government.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Prime Minister Li Qiang himself mentioned to me about Rongsheng.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: So therefore I expect the implementation to be much better
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: because we did not sign the MoU with the company that only announced as it happened before.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: About the employee expectations mentioned by these companies is 35,000
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: but I don't think he implementation of 35,000 will happen immediately.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: However, the initial stage required by Proton is 1,500 and other companies have not mentioned the number of jobs.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: However, when combined all 35,000 workers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Therefore, I request that these companies make sure first to hire local youth, both provide training programs.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Geely agreed to bring 300 youth to China for specialization training.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, may I have a second question?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Today there is no Oral Answer Question. This is rare.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Today is the last day of our school, the last day of school.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Okay.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Okay, thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: This side here. [ Stands up ] Mr. Speaker:
edus.speaker: Tuan Yusuf bin Abd Wahab [Tanjong Manis]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Tanjong Manis can?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yusuf bin Abd Wahab [Tanjong Manis]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Okay, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Honorable Prime Minister, I am aware that His Excellency's visit to China is more on investment and economic basis,
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but I want to ask relevant questions but it has to do with the country's investment and also the national economy, which is about the security aspect.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Does His Excellency in the opportunity to visit also discuss or whisper with the Chinese leadership about security in our region, especially when the presence of the Chinese Navy in the South China Sea which recently invited or invited the concerns of several major countries including Australia, the US and the UK until they formed a new alliance or a new fleet
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: called AUKUS or Australia, the UK and the US by providing a nuclear submarine that is said to be because of the Chinese influence in the Indo-Pacific region.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So does His Excellency also discuss this problem?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I remember the Honorable Kota Raja when he was the Minister of Defense he used to say elephant fight elephant, grass will suffer.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I think everyone, we are afraid of concern for national defense.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Did His Excellency discuss this aspect?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you very much.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: The Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kota Bharu.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Two things, first of all AUKUS's proposal which is said to be a nuclear-powered submarine.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: The Prime Minister of Australia contacted me by phone and sent a special representative to explain about this position.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Malaysia and ASEAN's position is not to support any effort that can increase tensions, especially in the military field.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Malaysia and ASEAN are free zones that do not want the feud between major powers to get closer to us.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So that's why, when AUKUS announced, Malaysia expressed anxiety and concern so that this matter does not explode as something that will be considered provocative that will cause China to increase their activities in the region.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Regarding the second question about Chinese activities.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Indeed, this matter was raised
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: because the two parties had overlapping claims in the South China Sea, especially the concern of China
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: because PETRONAS has carried out a mass activity in an area that is also closed by China.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: I mentioned this matter myself to Prime Minister Li Qiang and also President Xi Jinping that Malaysia considers this to be the area of the Malaysian district, so therefore, PETRONAS will continue to dig in the area.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: However, if China feels this is their right, we can open for negotiations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: However, in the meantime, we will continue our efforts to dig.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: I don't want to avoid continuing negotiations
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: because this is ASEAN's position.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: ASEAN feels that all overlapping claims should be resolved through negotiations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: However, so far, Malaysia insists that this is in Malaysia's area or region.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Regarding the presence of ships and so on, that is explained by China.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: That's international waters.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: However, the foreign ministry will continue to monitor
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: and if there is a violation,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: will issue objections.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Ipoh Barat.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Last day, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Well done to His Excellency in bringing large investments from China.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I want to ask a question about recent times where many countries no longer want to use US Dollars in transactions with other countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So in this situation, does the government want to be the same director which is to use Yuan in transactions with Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The second question is when will His Excellency go to India to bring investment just like China? [ Laughs ] [ Laughs ] Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Please Your Honor the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: At the BOAO conference in Hainan, I made a proposal openly about the Asian Monetary Fund so that it does not only depend on the dollar or to the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: When I throw that, I am interested
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: because when there is a meeting with President Xi Jinping, he keeps mentioning that he said I consulted Anwar's proposal on the Asian Monetary Fund and he will welcome it to discuss.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: The proposal about the financial fund is true.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: There is no reason why countries like Malaysia continue to depend on the dollar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: For example, in our negotiations Malaysia - Indonesia, we use both ringgit and rupiah.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: So at the same time, we are now continuing the discussion and Bank Negara is just pioneering this so that Malaysia can negotiate in terms of exports and imports with China using ringgit and renminbi.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: But what is bigger than that is about the Asian Monetary Fund.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: This is the initial stage.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: I once suggested as the Minister of Finance
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: but that matter was not well received in Asia
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: because at that time it was considered that the strength of the American Dollar was very strong.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: However, now with the economic strength of China, Japan and so on, I think it should be negotiated at least thinking about the Asian Monetary Fund.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Both, can use the ringgit and the finances of each state.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Regarding the visit to India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, I have to give some time to it.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Thank you very much. [ Laughs ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Another one is okay? Another one Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you for inviting the Honorable Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi, Kuala Langat.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: Dato 'Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi asked the Prime Minister to state: ( a ) and ( b ) justification of the government's actions to delist liquid products and nicotine gels used in electronic cigarette devices from the Poisons Act 1952; the government's consideration of the negative implications of delisting these liquid products and nicotine gels.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kuala Langat.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: In the presentation of the 2023 Budget on February 24, I announced about excise duty on liquid products containing nicotine.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: This is because this vape is widely used and the use of the vape even though I personally, the Ministry of Health and doctors do not encourage cigarettes or vapes
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: but because it is too widespread, it is taxed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: The only problem is implementation
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: because the smoking product bill that will be introduced this year, it gets a lot of negative reactions from Members of Parliament.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: Not rejecting, in principle we will continue to present this bill
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: but can not be done
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: because at the initial stage of the Honorable, we agree to be put together about this bill and also about the vape tax.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: However, due to many objections, we have suggested that the Honorable Minister of Health carefully renegotiate with Members of Parliament and with all health bodies with the intention of implementing.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: It means not to delay, to implement this year as well, God willing, because the bill is related to what the Honorable raised earlier.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: This is so that there is an understanding with some provisions, especially about implementation which is considered too harsh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: However, I think it is appropriate for us to give space to Members of Parliament to discuss whether it is in the Select Committee or others.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: However, at the current stage, the Customs Department will still control its distribution.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: I hope this bill can be presented for the next session in May.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: Meanwhile, the Awareness Advocacy Campaign on Pushing Vape and Rokok should be increased.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker and thank you Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Kuala Langat welcomes the pure agenda of this cigarette termination generation through planning to bring the Smoking Products Control Bill for Public Health 2023.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, when it was confirmed by the Honorable Minister of Health last Thursday that nicotine was removed from the list of Poisons Act 1952 solely to enable excise duty tax collection, it was very disappointing and seemed to reject views from professionals including the Malaysian Medical Association, the Malaysian Pharmacy Association, the Malaysian Tobacco Control Council, the Penang Consumer Association and several other NGOs that I think rejected on this excise when it was gazetted on March 31.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The content of this nicotine will cause addiction and diseases related to lung injuries caused by this e-vape or e-cigarette.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We get information that the cigarette tax collection in 2020 amounted to RM3 billion and we had to treat the effects of these smokers, the disease caused by this cigarette amounted to RM6.2 billion.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: It's an excessive amount.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Last 2022, we got information that RM1.5 million vape users in our country.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Is the expected RM2 billion tax collection capable of us possibly preventing diseases or addiction to electronic smokers?
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Will this achieve the goals of this generation of smokers' terminations in our country?
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What form of control in the lacuna, from us having approved, gazetted this excise duty collection until we approve this Smoking Products Control Bill.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Okay Dear Kuala Langat, long question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: Doesn't the government feel that it's as if we 're pawning our younger generation to addiction and also possibly a cigarette-related illness?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Good, thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: I understand.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: Although I am not a doctor, I understand the complaint of Yang Berhormat Kuala Langat and there is truth and there is propriety that we take actions to give awareness, train.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: However, take actions that are quite extreme in banning vape or cigarette nicotine, that is quite drastic and can not be handled by any country in the world.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: That's why many people choose to smoke even though we release a campaign and I combine it like alcohol.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: While we campaign negative effects,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: but we continue with this taxation just to not make the material spread widely and cheap.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: I agree Your Honor that professional health bodies all without except including doctors at home, do strongly oppose this matter.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: In the government's opinion, for the time being, we find it difficult to ban,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: but we can raise awareness so that people choose.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: There are scholars who ban cigarettes for example but smokers are still widespread and this is a problem that has happened for thousands of years.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: So, that's why the approach we take is quite simple, which is to impose taxes but strictly to ban in Parliament, in schools.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: This means that restrictions are widespread enough to avoid society, especially young people, vape or smoking.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: That's why we take a relatively simple approach.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]

edus.text: A little bit, Your Honor, may I?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Dr. Ahmad Yunus bin Hairi [Kuala Langat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Honorable Bandar Kuching.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker, thank you Honorable Prime Minister for the answer.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: In one of the most prominent cardiologists conventions in the world, there is a question asked to them.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Give advice to everyone to take care of heart health, almost 100 percent of them say don't smoke.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We know this is a very important issue.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I examined the Prime Minister's answer earlier to give a time frame for the table of the act in May.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I hope that the Prime Minister can give another strong commitment so that this May we have this act
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because it is very important.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We do not want to sideline the interests of public health, public health even though we want to collect taxes.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I also want to add a second question where in the budget presented by the Prime Minister, the Honorable said 50 percent of the tax will be returned to the Ministry of Health.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: May I ask if it is developed where 50 percent of all sin tax, tax cigarettes, tax vape will be returned for the treatment of these patients?
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: I know Yang Berhormat Bandar Kuching is also tough on this issue of smoking and vape.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: I agree
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: because I also prohibit, not only smoking but in my house area I can't smoke at all.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: That's my wife's command. [ Laughs ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: However, the first question is, will the government be firm in introducing the law as mentioned by the Minister of Health during the day?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: I answered, yes. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Our decision will clearly introduce.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: That delay, I apologize
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: because many Members of Parliament ask to review some provisions, not reject them at all.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Both of them are about the 50 percent revenue so far decided by the government, any revenue from this vaping tax 50 percent will be returned to the Ministry of Health to help health recovery measures
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: but we will reconsider it to others.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius Tangau asked the Prime Minister to state the total number of contract-appointed Medical Officers in the public service and the financial implications involved if all contract-appointed medical officers are absorbed in and subsequently appointed permanently.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to thank the Honorable Tuaran.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: First of all, I would like to express my appreciation and thank you to the contract doctors who have been facing problems for so long and have not continued with the plans of some parties who want to strike and so on because we pay attention.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: I give an example, as I mentioned in the 2023 Budget, the emolument allocation of 19.7 billion is allocated to the Ministry of Health which is an increase of RM3 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: This is not a small amount compared to 2022.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Of the RM3 billion additional emoluments, including RM1.2 billion annual salary increase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Additional allocations for the contract officer's needs of RM600 million and appointments to permanent positions absorbed from the contract officer RM1.1 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: So for the year 2023, additional
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: because the contract doctor and also the absorption of being a permanent officer, that's RM1.7 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: That's why I appeal, while the claim is reasonable that they serve for so long,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: but this matter has been delayed for so long.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: So, for this year we solve everything, we can't afford it.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: So what the government does is to add RM1.7 billion from the addition of RM3 billion emoluments for the year 2023.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: So, we expect that if this can be done within three years, it means we can absorb 12,800 contract doctors who are available within three years.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: This is because this year we absorb 4,300 people at once.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: This year alone 4,300 people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: because the total number is 20,333 contract training.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: A total of 12,800 housemanship.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: So we are not included in this category.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: So that's why I hope it can be understood that there is no intention of us to underestimate
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: because these doctors serve well, sacrifice time, time, energy and indeed the country needs.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: It's just that for this year, we add RM1.7 billion and from this additional RM 3 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: For me this is the maximum we can do.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: I once again thank them for their willingness to serve even though there is anxiety not satisfied
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: because they are not absorbed all of it once now.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: It is really challenging to absorb all these contract doctors.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What I want to know is that as an additional question is in terms of selection.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If we want to choose to be absorbed, what are the criteria used to select them as contract doctors?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Similarly, when promoted to JUSA, [ Unclear ] what are the criteria and does the government plan to give ... about the criteria?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The second additional question is in terms of on-call doctors' allowance.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I understand that it's only RM9 now compared to Starbucks RM20 if it's overtime.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Singapore, RM60.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: MMA has proposed RM25 per hour.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Does the government plan to follow the demands from MMA?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If so, when?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: The selection process is a process determined by the Public Service Commission.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Academic, experience, expertise and also performance and competence.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: That's the normal process.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: However, for this medicine, it includes what is called some additional tests included in the professional asssesment category of the officer.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: I don't think this is a problem raised
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: but the allowance has been raised.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: However, the allowance mentioned is apart from the salary and general allowance.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Although considered small, it is requested for additional but the current rate of duty allowance on the call of a medical officer which is on call whether to serve on a regular or contractual basis and ordered to carry out duties on the call after regular working hours in government hospitals, university hospitals, armed forces hospitals, or rural clinic hospitals is still in line with the setting of rates according to the day of the hour duty compared to the rates of other allowances received by other services.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Consisten.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: However, today I would like to take the opportunity to announce that additional allowances are given
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: because now these allowances are not included for those on duty at health clinics or emergency departments.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Therefore, I would like to announce that the government agrees that the duty allowance of a medical officer after office hours on call at the health clinic and the hospital's Emergency Department and expansion time is extended including weekly departure days to six health clinics involved in the pilot project to reduce government hospital congestion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: I have also instructed JPA and the Ministry of Finance to study that this facility be extended to all, apart from medical officers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Panglima Madius bin Tangau [Tuaran]

edus.text: Stone Stairway.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Good, please Honorable Tangga Batu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: Thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We always talk about contract doctors
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but there is one category that we overlooked, which is the Assistant Medical Assistant (PPP).
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I understand that there are two issues.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: One of the Ministry of Health Training Institutions and the other is private.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: During the COVID-19 era, the Ministry of Health took them from the private sector.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I was told that their contracts were not extended
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and some were laid off.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: A total of 800 people were waiting to be laid off.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We request that the government pay attention to those who were hired on a contract that came from private colleges.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: As far as our records are concerned, it is not true that they are stopped or not connected unless there are certain cases.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: However, I would like to assure Yang Berhormat Tangga Batu, that if there is a record that is stopped for no reason
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: or not connected, we will take action so that they can work all.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: This is because our policy is not only a doctor, [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]
everyone

edus.text: but all officers involved in this medical activity including medical assistants, pharmacies, and dental clinics that are included in this category are treated equally.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: It is possible that the Honorable Tangga Batu mentioned if they choose to quit or serve the private sector.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: That is indeed allowed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: However, if there is any list that can be submitted by the Honorable Tangga Batu, God willing, I will take action.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Bakri bin Jamaluddin [Tangga Batu]

edus.text: Mrs. Vivian Wong Shir Yee asked the Minister of Transport to state what the Malaysian Aviation Commission's ( MAVCOM ) long-term plan is to overcome the high price of airfare between the Peninsula and Sabah, especially during the festive season.
edus.speaker: Puan Vivian Wong Shir Yee [Sandakan]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
