edus.text: Okay, I invite Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad, Parit Sulong.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini Ahmad asked the Prime Minister to state the latest plan
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: regarding the de-dollarisation approach
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: to encourage trade between other countries using the Malaysian Ringgit currency
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and to what extent this initiative is welcomed by regional countries.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Parit Sulong.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Malaysia is now one of the most aggressive ASEAN countries in emphasizing the need,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: reducing dependence on the dollar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: And so far, we have received a response
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: but the cause is because
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: if we look at it
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: since the beginning of 2022,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: the federal reserves of the United States have increased interest rates by 525 basis points to a range of 5.25 percent to 5.50 percent.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: It means five times since December 2022.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Although Malaysia has only increased by 125 basis points for the same period.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: This causes effects and pressure on almost all currencies in the region
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: and as I have mentioned in this House,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: the worst is that Japan and Malaysia are also affected.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: The solution method apart from strengthening economic fundamentals from a growth,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: investment and deficit point of view is a matter of moving away from dependence on the dollar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Our success is only for a few countries so far, this is big.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: For example, it is the most successful with China.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Through what is mentioned, two.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: One, High Level Principle of the ASEAN Local Currency Transaction and the same principle is more or less with China.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: So, if you want to explain for example with this China in terms of Malaysia,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: the number is quite high.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: So if - even though it is around now increasing to 19.2 percent of the total trade, by solution with China,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: this is Thailand.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: China is yes.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: The current solution of the total trade is 25 percent.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: It means that RM39.2 billion is in the ringgit and renminbi currencies, from a total of 157 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: It means that China is the most successful due to a relatively high increase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: With Indonesia, now 16.7 percent to August 2023
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: which is RM10.7 billion from the rupiah and ringgit.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: With Thailand, 19.6 percent RM8.2 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: If we look at this, there is a favorable development
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: even though it is still far
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: because there has not been any action from other countries even though Vietnam, Cambodia has given a certificate through the Local Currency Settlement Framework signed in the recent ASEAN Meeting Agreement in Jakarta.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Please Parit Sulong.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Thank you for the answer and explanation from the Prime Minister earlier.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I just want to ask about some additional things.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Apart from Thailand, China and Indonesia, does the government have a proposal
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: to expand the use of local currencies with countries with high trade value with Malaysia, especially at the ASEAN level, the BRICS- Brazil, Russia, China, South Africa countries?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: And how can the government ensure
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: that the entry of foreign investment and trade between countries, especially from the United States, is not affected and at the same time, ensure that Malaysia remains an investment destination?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The fact is that the dollar is still the main strength in international trade.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Countries choose to use the dollar,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: even we have just met the agreement in ASEAN this year, so that other countries such as Vietnam, Cambodia I mentioned will be together.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: In terms of our highest trade, it is with Singapore 15 percent but as a trading country,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Singapore does not show too strong interest in using local currency.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: The second highest is China 13.8 percent
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: and China is among the most active countries to welcome
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: and this is both a country and the private sector.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: The only problem is when the company is involved in other international trade.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: So, they find it difficult to take into account the interests of only two countries.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Then, I don't see any interest in Japan, Hong Kong, we - the following
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: if you follow the order of trade interests is Thailand, Indonesia is in,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: Korea is not,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: India still uses India's foreign rupee use restrictions, except for Indian citizens.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: So, the negotiations may take time.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: The tenth place in Malaysia's export market is Vietnam.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: And Vietnam, its President or Prime Minister has already given instructions to speed up the negotiation process between these two countries.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: There is also a proposal to involve BRICS countries.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: This BRICS so far, the most significant is China
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: but there has not been any effort
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: to expand to Africa and Latin America,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: but I believe with ASEAN's success with China,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: it is a sign of guidance to make it possible
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: because there is a profit to strengthen both local currencies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Dr. Noraini binti Ahmad [Parit Sulong]

edus.text: I invite Kubang Pasu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Tan Sri Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: The Honorable Prime Minister of Tambun, first of all for me, this is a very good idea.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This re-dollarization issue is because we have a problem with the US exchange rate for so long.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: There used to be suggestions using dinars and so on.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: And we know there used to be a proposal,
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: at that time Tambun was the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The proposal to establish the East Asian Economic Caucus ( EAEC )
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but it got huge opposition and obstacles.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Does Tambun see this as an idea that will get opposition and obstacles from other countries,
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: especially countries where the US Dollar is published,
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which is the United States.
edus.speaker: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Kubang Pasu.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: The dinar proposal for us is a good proposal
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: because it is given an alternative.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: It does not harm the country,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: but strengthens the internal and domestic strength of the respective countries' economies and Islamic countries, especially, familiar with the position of dinar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: In fact, with the increase of more than USD1 trillion in the halal industry, other countries are already more aware of being given exposure about the needs of dinar,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: but from the efforts since the 90s, the serious response has not yet been there.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Discussions continue and this is one of the topics that we will refer back to in the meeting on the Islamic economy,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: the Islamic economy and finance held in Kuala Lumpur in December,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: which is the title, `` Want to Start ''.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Although in a limited situation,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: for example
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: if with China I mentioned earlier,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: around 25 percent is high.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: If five or six percent start of dinar use with Islamic countries,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: that is a good start
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: because it is given additional strength from dependence on the dollar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Wira Dr. Ku Abd Rahman bin Ku Ismail [Kubang Pasu]

edus.text: Okay, I invite Ipoh Barat.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I accept the efforts made by His Excellency
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: regarding this re-dollarization is good,
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but I want to ask about what specific benefits we will get,
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: specific benefits we will get with this process?
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: And lately, the US Dollar compared to the ringgit
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: has fallen very much.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The ringgit has fallen very much
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and for that reason, the price of goods has gone up.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The problem is, how can it be overcome?
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: And does the government think, there is sabotage that makes this matter,
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: where the Ringgit fell terriblely?
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Ipoh Barat.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: We will explain.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: In fact, we see the strength of the local currency, at the same time with the strength of other economic fundamentals.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: If other economic fundamentals, in terms of investment, growth, confidence fall,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: it means that the blame should be shouldered by all.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: But in this case, he involves all countries
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: and I mentioned that if you follow in terms of percentage,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: the worst thing is the Japanese Yen.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: I answered earlier,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: how in America there is a financial policy, a federal reserve that rises in terms of strength,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: gives strength to the dollar and our decision not to use the OPR alone to strengthen the ringgit.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: So, our rate hike, in basis point are very low and when America takes such actions,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: it causes capital to be pulled into America.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: The way we solve it,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: of course is not easy
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: because the dependence on the dollar is too strong in financial infrastructure now.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: So, among the suggestions mentioned earlier, about de-dollarization, as happened with - I remember a pretty good success
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: if a quarter or 25 percent of the value of the import trade with the Chinese country is in the ringgit and renminbi,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: it means that 25 percent is not dependent at all, not affected at all by the United States' decision.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: If we use the dollar,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: whatever happens in the United States particularly interest rate hikes,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: that will have a negative, adverse impact on our country,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: but if we start to expand,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: even if we can't reach 50 percent, 30-40 percent with each country,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: I think the impact would be more or less similar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: So, there is a need for us to more aggressively emphasize on countries,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: especially developing countries
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: that are not dependent -
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: too dependent on the American economy to be more free and independent from the reliance on the American Dollar.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Because the American decision does not care about the international financial system.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: It does not care about understanding in any international negotiations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: It only thinks about the importance of strengthening the American economy,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: even though the impact is unfair for developing countries.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: So, this is what is said to be a lack of system or infrastructure, international financial infrastructure.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Another one is okay?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Yes, we've already allowed three.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: We are moving to Dato' Rosol bin Wahid, Hulu Terengganu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Thank you President.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Before that, I would like to welcome the presence of our children, i.e. UTHM students
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: who came to Parliament this morning.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Welcome to Parliament. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu] ask the Prime Minister to state what the government's guarantee is that the move to float the price of chicken and eggs will not burden the people
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: who are facing a high cost of living.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you, please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Hulu Terengganu.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: I want to explain first, how much is the government's total subsidy for chicken and eggs since 2022.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: That reaches RM3.7 billion just to cover the cost of chicken and eggs.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: So, who gets the benefit?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Of course the people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: I agree with Hulu Terengganu that it should take care of the interests of the people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: but the current approach is benefits 3.5 million foreigners,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: that's the first.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: The second, raised by Yang Berhormat yesterday,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: is about what I categorize as a rich group.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: It's not about anti-rich,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: it's not an additional tax from them,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: it means that the subsidy is not for the rich.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: That's all, like Tabung Haji.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: We impose,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: give subsidies to the people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: But if his income is RM100,000 a month and above,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: the subsidy should not be given to him.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: That's what I mean.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: In this context, how can we avoid this RM3.7 billion being used solely among our people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: who have the right to reject the richest 10 percent and 3.5 million foreigners.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: This approach we make is to see the current market price situation.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: When the price is less than the ceiling price as it is now
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: and the price of chicken and eggs in Thailand is lower than Malaysia,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: then this is the time when we float.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Yes,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: if it is true that there is a shortage
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: and I agree with what is your concern.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: So, we will spread it from the stock.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: The Ministry of Agriculture has 30 percent of chicken and egg stock
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: and is ready.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: I have told you, the Minister is also there,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: to buy from Thailand,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: if there is a need to avoid the price going up.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: That's as far as the guarantee we can do.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: But, why do we do it now,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: because the price is down
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: and the supply is large.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: 30 percent stock
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: , the price in Thailand is much lower.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: There is no reason why we can not wave,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: if there are businesses that take advantage of raising prices.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: One more follow-up.
edus.speaker: Seorang Ahli
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Yes, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Oh, sorry Hulu Terengganu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Please, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Please Hulu Terengganu, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Thank you Speaker,
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: thank you Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What is the government's guarantee that there will be no more flip-flops or what the people of Terengganu refer to as 'keluk kelek'
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because we know it was previously announced that this subsidy will be terminated on July 1.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Then after two weeks, it was withdrawn
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and the question is whether this matter is not repeated for the second time?
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The second, will this float affect the increase in the consumer price index,
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which ultimately directly affects the lives and inflation of the people, the weakening state of the ringgit value,
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which the Leader of the Opposition at that time – the Leader of the Opposition said that ..
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Unclear ]
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: this is weak
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because of the weakness of the Prime Minister's management at that time.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's another matter.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, the third question is,
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when will the Minister of KPDNHEP or Cost of Living be appointed?
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you President.
edus.speaker: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Regarding this decision, I announce it in the budget.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: When we announce the budget decision,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: it is a policy decision.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: The past change was because the initial decision to stop subsidies had been made.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: So, the ministry of agriculture just continued.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: It's just that when the appeal comes to me,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: I ask for it to be extended
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: because there is no clear policy yet to resolve.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: In the current case, those officials at the Ministry of Agriculture, KPDHEP have also convened with the Ministry of Finance.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: How much subsidies can be saved,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: how much additional assistance for Rahmah can be added,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: how much LPP and FAMA can afford to help in terms of marketing infrastructure.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: After thinking about all that, then we announce the policy.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: The Minister of Agriculture will announce in detail the implementation date in the near future.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: So, I don't think the flip-flop issue arises.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: The issue of the Prime Minister's weakness is okay.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: I am also willing to accept the reprimand
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: because I am not as perfect as Yang Berhormat Hulu Terengganu.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: So, I accept the reprimand.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: I can fix it.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: And what is the possibility of the impact on the consumer price index?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: So far, the market price includes the wholesale market even though the ceiling in Sabah, Sarawak is higher but for us,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: it is still low and the price in Thailand is low.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Meaning,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: if there is an effort to increase,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: the mitigation step is from the production of stocks and purchases from Thailand,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: this ringgit can curb
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: and also enforcement.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Those are the steps we take and God willing,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: this decision is a firm and final decision.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato' Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]

edus.text: Please Paya Besar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I thank the government for always thinking about the welfare of the people.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: But, there are two questions of His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The first thing is,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if we give this subsidy to the companies,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We continue to give it to the people,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: instead of giving it to the companies, as there are leakages, do we have the ability to distribute in terms of FAMA, in terms of agencies.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We straight trasnfer the cash to the people
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: so that the people can access it directly
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and the people can make their own decisions.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The second, Yang Berhormat Tambun mentioned earlier about 3.5 million foreigners.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, what is our policy?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Will our policy have implications for foreign countries?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The source countries that send workers to Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: [ Cough ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Sorry.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Pekan's proposal about cash payment is a good suggestion
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: because it was introduced before but it just can't be for all.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: That is being thought about in some other more complex steps.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: But, in the case of chicken and eggs this is not necessary,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: because the price has dropped
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: and we have -
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: I say plan contingency in terms of stock
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: and also the market,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: not only in cheap Thailand,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: in China is also cheap.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: So, therefore the current move is considered reasonable.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: It is not directed at companies, not as it was suggested.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: The proposal for cash transfer is being considered for several other matters
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: and may be announced.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: So, I remember that was what was asked for an explanation from Yang Berhormat about the approach,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: whether directly to the people through cash transfer,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: which is indeed thought about in some other issues that we will announce,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: which is bigger to avoid leakage and benefits to foreigners.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: What was raised again is the issue of the impact on foreign workers or foreigners.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: I think they came here to get salary, not to get subsidies
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: and we also have a policy
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: to give reasonable and fair to everyone,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: including those who are not citizens
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: but no country should subsidize foreigners.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: So, this principle, Your Honor, is to avoid subsidies that should be returned to the people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: They call it subsidy,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: which is essentially a charity.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: So it is unreasonable that we want to give charity to foreigners and charity to the rich.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: That is the principle of why we should hold the subsidy targeting that we are talking about now.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Dato’ Indera Mohd Shahar bin Abdullah [Paya Besar]

edus.text: Okay, I 'll invite Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Just mention, perhaps I can mention the currency of the ringgit currency
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when His Excellency Tambun mentioned the yen earlier.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The yen with the Malaysian Ringgit is still the same value
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if calculated without the US Dollar, 17 October 2022 and 17 October 2023.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, maybe there is still further explanation that can be presented,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: just regarding the price of this item Dear Sir, what our Members of Parliament raised is when SST is increased to eight percent.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We know that this supply chain food prices for this end user are not born from the food itself,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: it is born from the manufacturing, packaging and other services sectors.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: In the end it will produce the price of goods that are feared to increase.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's right, we 're not checking in hotels every day
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but what is worrying is the effect of the domino effect on the supply chain.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's what the Members of Parliament raised that will eventually cause the prices of the goods that the user wants to buy to be high.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: How can Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun explain this situation?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Sorry, Pasir Mas sorry.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I had Kubang Kerian on my mind.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Pasir Mas, regarding the solution of any problem
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: , I agree
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: but it is not in the answer framework earlier,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: that is, any problem is not only seen in terms of market prices.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: It should also be seen in terms of production,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: whether there are more serious measures
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: either through local investment to increase productivity or to encourage foreign investment to come.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Among the reasons why local companies are not ready to invest in the issue of chicken, eggs and the refusal of large companies
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: including Thailand to enter
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: is because the price is uncertain,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: the government's intervention in terms of prices makes them not ready.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: So, now if we leave it to the market
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and if the people are in trouble
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: we give foreign injections,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I remember that will give space to the companies to invest.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: So this is a matter of preparation, a matter of supply and indeed we have, we have to take care of this balance.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: If we continue with the current policy, it has been years
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and there is no new investment or investment
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because he said we can not invest
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because we don't know, the price is as far as the government can intervene.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: We can not use our own projections.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Therefore, we make a little adjustment stating that for this, we give market forces.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: There is concern about the price increase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: We deal with it through
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: even if we are desperate,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: cash transfer directly to the people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because we already have STR that we can increase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: That is one of the reasons why for November and next year I increase the amount of STR assistance from RM8 billion to RM10 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: That takes into account the hardships, hardships of the people's lives.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: So, it is not true if we say we do not care.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Your Honor, the session for Minister's Question Time is now over today.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]
