edus.text: I invite Mr. Jimmy Puah Wee Tse ( Tebrau ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Thank you Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse asked the Minister of Women, Family and Community Development to state what steps the ministry is taking to reduce the increasing cases of child abuse in Malaysia
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita
Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: and what assistance will be given to children who are abused after being found?
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita
Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Tebrau.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, there are various factors that lead to abuse.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Among them are drug abuse, alcohol influence, family relationship problems, mental or emotional health and others.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: In general, cases of child abuse can occur
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: when children are in the care of their own family members
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: and also when children are in the care of others, such as caregivers either at home, daycare or daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: As a measure to reduce the risk of child abuse while in the care of others, especially in daycare, the Department of Social Welfare ( JKM ) has outlined several improvements to implement, among them the following things:
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: ( i ) we streamline our enforcement team and under this initiative the establishment of the Department of Child Development I just announced before that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: We will reorganize the placement of officers in each district by placing officers
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: who will focus on carrying out monitoring duties and enforcement actions, especially for daycare centers and daycare only.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: This will start in 43 districts identified as risky areas
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: and we will implement it this year as well;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: ( ii ) we tighten the rules and guidelines for the installation of CCTV in daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Third, we too.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Apart from that, we also, entrepreneurs need to ensure that there are no blind spots or with permission, blind spots in CCTV coverage except for privacy places such as bathrooms and clothing dressing places;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: ( iii ) tighten the screening process for the recruitment of caregivers in daycare and also daycare centers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: JKM will discuss together with the Ministry of Home Affairs
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: and also the PDRM to explore the proposal to require a screening of safety for candidates who want to work as caregivers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Next, we will also see these babysitter candidates whether together with daycare operators will be required to undergo psychometric tests.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: Meanwhile, efforts to reduce the risk of child abuse while in family care require a different approach.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]

edus.text: This is because KPWKM and JKM have direct control over daycare and daycare centers through the provisions of the law and regulations set.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: Because we know that all this time there are many neighbors who inform the authorities.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: And for us when we are informed to us, our protector has authority or authority, with permission, to go and take the child from the house
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: if it is found that it is no longer suitable to be left there,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: while the police case investigates and then, while the police will give us feedback.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: We will take actions that depend on our authority.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: There are also us who need to take it to court again to get power from the court, orders from the court to allow us whether we can bring the child to our institution.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: And there are many more actually support
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: and also ways for us.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: However, I want to state here that more cases that happen are in our own family, than in daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: If it's daycare,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: it's easy for us to take legal action
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: but if it's in our own family,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: if there is already legal action,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: it's up to the court too.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Dr. Abd Ghani bin Ahmad [Jerlun]

edus.text: So, I will give specific statistics, God willing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [ Kuala Krau ] ask the Minister of Education to state the ministry's steps in dealing with the issue of the percentage of upper secondary students participating in the STEM flow from 2017 to 2022
edus.speaker: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: which recorded a 45.2 percent decrease to 40.94 percent including the role of the STEM Committee established.
edus.speaker: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: for your information,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: the Malaysian Ministry of Education is always trying to develop knowledgeable and skilled human capital to participate in the flow of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics ( STEM ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: As of August 2023,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: the Ministry of Education's data shows that the percentage of STEM student enrollment has shown an increase, from 40.95 percent in 2021 to 45.73 percent in 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: the Ministry of Education has implemented various proactive measures.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Among them are included in the Malaysian Education Development Plan
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: which emphasizes increasing student interest through a new learning approach and curriculum strengthening.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Increase the skills and abilities of STEM teachers as well as increase the awareness of parents, the public of STEM and increase their awareness.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Efforts to increase the competence of teachers in strengthening teaching
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: and learning activities in and outside the classroom are also among the steps implemented to increase student interest,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: further encouraging them to choose STEM flow at a higher level of study.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: For your information, the Ministry of Education always pays attention to the readiness of infrastructure to support STEM education, as announced.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: In the 2024 Budget, for example, a sum of RM100 million was provided for the empowerment of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics specifically for the purpose of maintaining and upgrading computer labs as well as procurement of new equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: In addition, another allocation of RM254 million was approved for the supply of primary school design educational equipment and the purpose of modifying the upgrade of primary school technology design rooms in the Third Rolling Plan
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: and all these provisions show the government's seriousness to support STEM education.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: For your information, the synergy between the ministries is also strengthened including with the Ministry of Science, Technology, the Ministry of Higher Education and the Ministry of Human Resources to strengthen the STEM education ecosystem.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Your Honor, the Ministry of Education also cooperates with the PETRONAS Foundation to implement the Teacher Ambassador Program to empower 4,500 STEM teachers in improving high-level thinking skills through STEM education.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: This program is expected in the context to be a long-term program with the industry,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: to strengthen the ability of STEM teachers in schools and this program intends to produce a generation of future solvers of problems.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Dear Sir, I would also like to emphasize that we are also involved in international scoring such as the Programme for International Student Assessment ( PISA ) with permission, Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study ( TIMSS ), with permission and Southeast Asia Primary Learning Metrics.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Participation in international scoring studies is very important to help assess the extent of the education system in Malaysia compared to the country's high-achieving education system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: In addition, this participation is in line with Malaysia's MADANI desire, especially the value of sustainability, well-being and copyright.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Lastly, Yang Berhormat asked about the role of the STEM Committee established.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: For your knowledge, the STEM Education Committee consisting of the STEM Education Steering Committee and the STEM Education Technical Committee to coordinate any efforts to strengthen STEM education through the empowerment of strategic cooperation across ministries, departments, State Education Departments and District Education Offices and schools.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: This committee is a platform to discuss critical issues of STEM education that require immediate decisions and solutions to ensure that the goals of STEM education are achieved.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Kuala Krau.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Speaker, the question through the Honorable Minister's answer earlier, is the ministry also ready to explore an initiative of foreign countries in fostering STEM education, through an innovative new STEM curriculum framework, thus attracting students' interest in the field?
edus.speaker: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: For example, in Japan, they implement comprehensive reforms of the education system through the GIGA school program to improve the digital literacy and creativity of students.
edus.speaker: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: While Canada takes an approach to deliver this education program by targeting individuals who are less attention-grabbing such as less able children, rural youth to get exposure to STEM careers such as coding, robotics, science engineering and the environment.
edus.speaker: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you President.
edus.speaker: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: For your information, we always implement the strengthening of the STEM curriculum from time to time.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: That's why, Your Honor, in this new budget it is also emphasized about an important, big and significant program for national education, namely the Future Education Tour.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: [ Stand up ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, I hope the involvement and engagement involving the entire community will be able to help us drive this STEM better.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: I agree Your Honor ...
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: [ Unclear ]

edus.text: ... Your Honor's view on looking at other countries' initiatives as well.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: That's why, Your Honor, we are quite committed to ensuring that we should prepare our international benchmarks in terms of preparations with the three contexts earlier, TIMSS, PISA and also SEA-PLM to ensure that in terms of the achievements and abilities of our children can be recognized internationally.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

edus.text: Thank you Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Kamal bin Ashaari [Kuala Krau]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Experience in education,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: where if we look at the early 80s, 70s where the handover of rural children who had to enter the science stream
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: even though the results at the level at that time, PMR or SRP were not very good.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: But because the government put the science policy forward,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: he has his program.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: So, what I suggest here or Sri Gading's findings is that most students who don't want to enter this science stream or this STEM,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: he is afraid of additional mathematics, afraid of physics.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Summarize the question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Science subjects.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: So, what are the early steps for Form 1, Form 3 students, the early steps for primary schools, so that rural students are interested?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The second, what are the counseling steps at the school level to bring or highlight about the careers they can get,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: as a result of good results in this STEM?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you Your Honor for your concern and Your Honor's observation of students related to STEM.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Your Honor, allow me to reiterate Your Honor, that in this STEM education what we do,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: the first is in the context of strengthening this curriculum is that students are encouraged to implement inquiry-based learning, project-based learning and problem-based learning in the context of the real world.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Then we also strengthen teachers in terms of suggesting to use various student-centered learning approaches,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: focus on high-level thinking skills,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: in addition to optimizing the use of technology.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: That's why, Your Honor, we have also reintroduced science practice tests at the Malaysian Certificate of Education level starting in 2021, to ensure that these people feel the truth of the process
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and also learning based on projects
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and also this science practice
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and also with concern, with permission, Your Honor about additional mathematics and so on, we will strengthen the Honorable in terms of pedagogy
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and also learning, teacher competence.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: During this tour later, I request that everyone get involved
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and give those views.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Where is the space we can strengthen this STEM?
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Your Honor brought an opinion on additional mathematics.

edus.text: So, these views, Your Honor, need to be included in this series of future education tours and traits so that we can get input for the preparation of the 2027 curriculum.

addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda bin Hassan [Sri Gading]

addressees: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: I invite Mr. Khoo Poay Tiong, City of Melaka.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Good morning Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Speak without using the speaker ]
edus.speaker: Beberapa Ahli
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Smile a little Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Laughs ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: It's scary when Speaker ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Speak without using the speaker ]
edus.speaker: Seorang Ahli
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Deputy Speaker, the achievement of the national contingent to the Asian Games is truly proud
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and today, this honorable Dewan Rakyat, is visited by none other than athletes, coaches and officials from the national contingent to the Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We welcome their presence.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong asked the Minister of Youth and Sports to state the achievements of Malaysian athletes in the 2023 Asian Games in Hangzhou recently
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: and what is the ministry's plan for preparing athletes and sports development for the upcoming international level sports.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: At the Hangzhou Asian Games recently, the Malaysian contingent consisting of 288 athletes has successfully won as many as six gold medals, eight silver medals and 18 bronze medals bringing the total number of 32 medals
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and has achieved the target given by the National Sports Council and the Malaysian Olympic Council.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: On this occasion, I would like to thank Chef de Mission, Dato' Chong, Deputy Chef de Mission, National Sports Council, National Sports Institute and the Malaysian Olympic Council for your efforts and hard work in making the Asian Games this time a success for Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: 13 types of medal contributors show good progress compared to the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta–Palembang, Indonesia and the 2014 Asian Games, Incheon, South Korea.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We still achieve more than the medal target even though two types of sports, namely tenpin bowling and silat, are not contested in the Hangzhou Asian Games this time.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is because two types of tenpin bowling and silat sports have contributed as many as 12 medals at the 2018 Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For further planning, the National Sports Council will hold an Asian Sports Performance Review Workshop with related stakeholders in the near future
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and will involve experts from Nippon Sport Science University on November 8.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For the Cambodia SEA Games as well, the same post-mortem workshop has been held to improve the existing program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, national athletes have shown extraordinary performance this time in their respective events and this successful performance that has been arranged has paid off.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I also on behalf of the Ministry of Youth and Sports thank the Prime Minister for recently announced an allocation of 72 million in the 2024 Budget
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and this is an increase of 31 percent,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: compared to 55 million last year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: I believe that with the Cabinet's encouragement and the allocation that will be approved by the Dewan Rakyat, our athletes will have strong support to face the upcoming competition.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Melaka City.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Yes, thank you for the answer given by the Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Minister, we should give credit yes to the national athletes for their efforts to sacrifice their time,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: energy and also their young age.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: `` 1030 We should also want to thank the coaches, officials and also members of the athletes' families.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: So my question is that in 264 athletes, how many athletes have represented Malaysia for the first time or went to this Asian Games and among them how many have received medals?
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Apart from that, has the ministry done a study or analysis, what are the main factors to the success of the Malaysian contingent's achievements this time?
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: And there are also people who wonder why they only send athletes in the top eight to compete.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: That's all, thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: This has exceeded one additional question Mr. Speaker
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: but I am trying.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For the statistics of how many athletes were for the first time, 39 people compared to a total of 288 people, made their first appearance.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For the winning factor, I do not have a complete list of athletes' names
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: but there are some athletes
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: who have performed exceptionally and brilliantly.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Among them is the success of national squash athlete Sivasangari, winning two gold medals in the women's team event and women's singles and this shows that the vacancy left by Datuk Nicol Ann David has already been filled.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Ng Eain Yow has also fought all out to win the men's singles gold medal.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Mohd Qabil Ambak Mahamad Fathil has made history winning the first gold medal for the national equestrian sport
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and he is present here
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Nur Shazrin Mohamad Latif gold medal sailing event and qualified on merit to the Paris Olympic Games this year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Mohd Arif Afifuddin Malik's success has ended the wait for karate to win the gold medal to set aside his opponent from Kazakhstan in the men's under-84 kilo way.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Shereen Samson Vallabouy won the 400 meter athletics bronze medal
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and this ended the 45-year wait for the national athlete to win a medal at the Bangkok Asian Games 1978.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Muhammad Azeem bin Mohd Fahmi won the bronze medal
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and this is also the last time the national athlete won a medal was through Datuk Rabuan Pit at the 1982 Delhi Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: The women's 4x100 meter quartet bronze medal victory ended the 57-year wait for the athletics team and Muhammad Sharul Aimy made his own history
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: when he won a bronze medal in the round event at the Hangzhou Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: The cycling women's sprint team also attended them for the first time to make their own history
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: when they first won a bronze medal in the team sprint event at the Asian sports games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: To summarize this winning factor, I see several factors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: One is the exposure of competitions and training exposure
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: that has been allocated by the National Sports Council involving an expenditure of RM9.4 million, 119 exposure to overseas competitions and 41 exposure of training has been given to athletes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: The Sports Match Grant also plays a role when we look especially at karate competitions,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: when they have a tournament like this organized in Malaysia has helped them improve their performance at the Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: But finally this winning factor, I give it to their athletes
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: because I see the athletes themselves with their own abilities
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and I believe these medal winners who I have read their names, they become medal winners
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: because they won in their minds
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: before they entered the ring.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: That is a winning factor
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and is also closely related to the efforts of the sports association.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

addressees: everyone

addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg to propose that the Criminal Procedure Code (Amendment) Bill (No. 2) 2023 be read for the second time now.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the bill I will present is the Criminal Procedure Code (Amendment) Act (No. 2) 2023
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: which aims to amend the Criminal Procedure Code [Act 593], which arose from the amendment to the Penal Code [Act 574], among other things, to abolish the confiscation of attempted suicide by a child or person with a lack of mental ability or by any person as a criminal offense.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This bill was presented for the first reading on April 4, 2023 together with the Penal Code (Amendment) Bill (No. 2) 2023.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, in general the amendment of Act 593 covers two clauses as follows:
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: ( i ) clause 1 contains a brief title and provisions on the commencement of the proposed act; ( ii ) clause 2 aims to amend the First Schedule to Act 593 which arising from the amendments made to sections 305 and 306 of the Penal Code which is Act 574 and the deduction of section 309 of the Penal Code.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The amendments involved for the First Schedule of Act 593 are to replace the details related to section 305 of the Penal Code with the details as stated in the table in clause 2.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Further, the relevant amendments are related to the details related to section 306 of the Penal Code in space (2) of the First Schedule which is by including the word 'or attempted suicide' after the word 'of suicide' under the section.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This matter is in line with the purpose of introducing the offense of attempted suicide by any person other than the category of individual person specified under the amendment of section 305 of Act 574.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The last amendment involved is to cut the details related to section 309 of the Penal Code and the details related to it.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Through the repeal of section 309 of the Penal Code,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: attempted suicide is no longer an offense under Act 574 after this.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: With this Mr. Speaker, I beg to propose.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
