edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I take this opportunity as a backbancher again to appeal to the existing Deputy Minister and the government, His Excellency the Prime Minister so
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
everyone

edus.text: that we can discuss the amendment to the SOSMA law where the individuals accused under SOSMA can at least be given bail with strict conditions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: For example, handing over a passport to the court, for example such as being prohibited from leaving the house at a certain time and so on.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Honorable Jelutong.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: I - please Honorable Bangi.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]

edus.text: I want to interrupt a little.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: I agree with what Yang Berhormat Jelutong said about SOSMA and about the guarantee.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I have also represented those accused under this SOSMA law.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Speaking of mental health issues, I have also represented clients who have experienced mental health
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but have not received bail
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: because under section 13 only a few categories can be given bail
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and this does not include those who may have mental health.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, I want to support what Yang Berhormat Jelutong said in this matter.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Bangi for the support that has been expressed.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]

edus.text: So Mr. Speaker, I once again fully appreciate the services of the Deputy Minister, Minister, the Prime Minister of the leadership for the initiatives that have been taken, for the Libat Urus Session in Parliament, outside Parliament, in prison, in police stations and so on.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We are aware that this government is the Madani Government which always has the welfare of the people in their attention.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: `` 1710 I am here taking the opportunity to - only once again plead and request the Honorable Deputy Minister that immediate steps be taken to amend the SOSMA law so that the individuals accused under the SOSMA can be given bail pending their trial in court.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: That's it, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Jelutong.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: I invite the Tumpat.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I would like to ask the government in relation to the 2023 Criminal Procedure Code ( Amendment ) Bill.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: First, related to cases involving mothers who are in confinement.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: In some cases that have recently been reported there are several cases of postpartum, mothers who give birth.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: If we look at the report from the health side,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: this PPD case happens in one of 500 cases.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, there are also cases so that these mothers can hurt themselves or kill the children they take care of after they have experienced stress
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after giving birth.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, in this case we may be able to realize that it is not a case involving a normal murder case but more of them experiencing emotional stress.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, as informed by the Honorable Deputy Minister earlier that the assessment for medical health will be done after 24 hours
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and taken to a psychiatric hospital to be accessed.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, does this also involve mothers or women who may have experienced stress
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after they give birth?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, will we monitor this mental health as a whole
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: because the number of cases according to 2022,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: the birth of life in Malaysia amounted to 439,744 people in 2021.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This involves almost 500,000 people.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, if one per 500 of us have approximately 800 mothers who are at risk.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, in this regard I request the government in which we approve the act related to this procedure to work intra-agency and inter-agency to ensure that the entire agency involved who can detect, has the potential to detect potential people who may shame this act
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: is given real attention.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because in the case I visited last month, the mother had already received treatment at the health clinic but maybe
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: because they did not assess her as bad,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: they let her go back
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and in the end there was a death to the mother involved.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This gives a very deep case to the children
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and also the husband and family of the mother.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: In this regard, I request that the government in approving this make a SOP in the agencies involved, especially to the Malaysian Ministry of Health and also maybe at the police station to have certain SOPs to prevent this treatment.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Second, related to this crime as well.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: We find that often they will choose certain locations.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, will the government in an effort to prevent
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and reduce suicide cases will close and ensure and do activities to prevent potential locations.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: For example, having CCTV, officers or closing location
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: so that it does not become a hotspot location for those who may use the opportunity to commit suicide.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because for them, their cases are resolved even though they have emotional stress
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but it causes commotion and anxiety for the community as a whole.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Third, from the point of view involving the media's reporting method, especially the journalists and TV in reporting cases involving suicide.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because, the reporting method in the media, in the media and also in movies sometimes we see causing encouragement, catalyzing others to do the same.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I think in this regard there needs to be a guideline so that this report should be reduced or ensured to be reported in very minimal conditions so as not to give other people the opportunity to do the same.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Also we see that one of the things that causes stress among the victims or potential perpetrators
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: is because of the many pressure
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: experienced in the community.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, among the things that happen we see today many people use the word stress.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Stress in life, stress in work, stress in learning.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, if only we could increase our colleagues.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: If in school there is a scheme or Rakan Sebaya Guide.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: In the department, we may have a counselor.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, it may need to be created in a private or government department
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: so that more friends can also be created who can help to reduce this stress among staff and workers.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Now we see today, the pressure we face is very much.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Regarding the issue related to suicide, we also see - in this case we see as if everything is bona fide which is the party that does nothing
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but because they have mental inability.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, how in cases that are also actually seen
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: as if suicide but have a mala fide.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: In this regard, the evidence and forensics I think will still be made on the police side
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: before we say that it died suddenly or suicide.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because we see that there are several cases that were reported suicide at the initial stage
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after an inquest under the Coroner's Court found that it is not a suicide case but a murder case.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, in the case called suicide even today,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: this bill is passed, we request that all the evidence and evidence related to the case should be held well so that we do not let go of any party that may have a mala fide in certain cases, especially involving celebrities
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and has the potential to be killed but use the method
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: as if they are experiencing stress to the point of being able to commit suicide.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: As informed by Yang Berhormat Jelutong earlier, the husband and wife who were found suddenly both under a building in Genting Highlands.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: That is also an action or case that we can estimate as maybe having a mala fide from certain parties.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: In this regard as well, I also request the government to provide a support and medical system to the families of the victims
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: because when this happens even though it is no longer made into a crime
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but they will still experience stress and shame that is very extraordinary.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This requires a support system maybe within three months or six months to their families
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: so that they can both take care
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and ensure that our desire to reduce this crime can be reduced with the approval of the bill today.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Tumpat.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.text: I invite the Honorable Kampar.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker for giving me the opportunity to debate this bill.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I continue to enter the crime of suicide.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This act of suicide was included in Malaysian law by British colonialists since 1936.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, in 1961, British colonialists themselves in their laws have decriminalized suicide.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, Malaysia still remains with this crime until today.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: To this day based on the United for Global Mental Health, there are only 20 countries that still consider this suicide act as a crime and Malaysia is still one of those countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, I see this is a very late action
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but luckily today we present this bill to decriminalize suicide.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: One very rational question that we can all throw is that when a person wants to commit suicide, the person really wants to commit suicide himself
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but how do the crisis intervention officer or fire department or negotiator, how do the officer advise the person not to commit suicide?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: ' Please don't commit suicide! If you are saved you can impose a 10-year, 20-year prison sentence'.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: That's not reasonable at all.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: The person is already about to die.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: He wants to commit suicide.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, I think we should decriminalize this suicide act.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Secondly, I want to know if the action or decriminalization of this suicide act is it a retrospective?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because, we know there is already a moratorium on this crime.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, we hope the Honorable Deputy Minister can give an enlightenment.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Third, the Honorable Deputy Minister did not say about cyberbullying.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I think this is an issue that we need to deal with.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because,
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: if we look at two years ago in Malaysia there is a Youtuber, he tried to commit suicide.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I don't know how the video is displayed on Facebook Live.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: The fire department tried to save him suddenly near the comments of many netizens,
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: 'Don't make drama! If you want to jump, jump. Want to die, go die'.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is all cyberbullying, abetment of suicide.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: How did the Honorable Minister say earlier that under the law we can take action.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, is it taken action?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Until today I don't see any netizens being prosecuted.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I have a question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: If the netizen is abroad,
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: in Singapore, in the UK, in the US, he tried to provoke someone to commit suicide on Facebook, on YouTube.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: What action can be taken?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I think maybe we need an act or even a special section to deal with the specific cyber-bullying problem like this.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Lastly, I once handled a case in my area, where a person - the head of his family had committed suicide
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and I tried to apply for the allocation of the state government at that time to help this family
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but it was rejected because at that time suicide was still a crime.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, the state government was rejected.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I think this is not fair
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: because the family is already in distress.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Why do we want to victimize his wife who is not working?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Why do we want to victimize children who are still living in distress?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I think we need to have a change of all SOPs.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Government allocations can be used to help families who lose their lives in suicide
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after we pass this bill.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, that's all my debate.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kampar.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: I ask the Honorable Minister to answer in 15 minutes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Since there are only three debaters, I think these issues are not many.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I will start with Yang Berhormat Jelutong.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: Yang Berhormat Jelutong has already taken the opportunity to ask about SOSMA,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: and whether steps will be taken by the government
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: to be guaranteed for SOSMA cases and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]

edus.text: Yang Berhormat Bangi has also stood up to support the SOSMA debate.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Syahredzan bin Johan [Bangi]

edus.text: For the information of Mr. Speaker, of course the SOSMA engagement sessions have already started to be held.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: It has been several months together, of course, this is led by the Ministry of Home Affairs (KDN)
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: but BHEUU also participated in engagement sessions to help in this effort.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Of course, the issue of improving SOSMA includes the guarantee issue, is currently being studied very carefully.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We will see the progress in the near future.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: That's my answer regarding SOSMA.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer a/l Rajaji [Jelutong]
addressees: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]

edus.text: I would also like to refer to the Honorable Member Tumpat who asked questions regarding the need for the agencies involved to detect postnatal mothers who are at risk of suicide.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.text: In this connection, Mr. Speaker, the Ministry of Health provides screening services and mental health interventions to identify those involved.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: If accused,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: a reference can be made to a psychiatric hospital under Section 342 of the Criminal Procedure Code.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: In addition, the defense under Section 84 of the Penal Code can also be raised during the trial.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Section 84 of the Penal Code as stated, I have referred to it earlier.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The Honorable Member Tumpat also asked how journalists and the media are more sensitive in their reporting.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.text: The Ministry of Health has prepared suicide reporting guidelines for the media.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.text: However, the implementation needs to be improved through the cooperation of relevant agencies and ministries
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.text: since it is only a guideline at this time.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Dato’ Mumtaz binti Md Nawi [Tumpat]

edus.text: Finally, regarding Yang Berhormat Kampar, he asked if this law is retrospective.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: The answer is,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: it does not expressly state that it is retrospective but it will apply as soon as possible
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: after it is given the approval of The Royal Lesson.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: Before that, moratorium cases will still be enforced.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: So, for the upcoming cases, this new legal case will apply including for those under the moratorium.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: Just want a little clarification.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]

edus.text: If it is still a law that used before,
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]

edus.text: what is the point of the moratorium?
edus.speaker: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]
addressees: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]

edus.text: No, no.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: Once it comes in two effects,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: then it will apply for all cases that have not yet started.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: I think that's all the issues that have already been raised by the three debaters earlier.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Tuan Chong Zhemin [Kampar]

edus.text: As I said Mr. Speaker, there are only three debaters.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So, I don't need 15 minutes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: That's all.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman asked the Minister of Rural and Regional Development to state based on the recent proposal to create a paid Mara Junior College of Science ( MRSM ) to the able group, please the Minister explain: ( a ) what is the process and funding source to build this paid MRSM
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: and when it will be implemented; and ( b ) what is the process of selecting students for admission to this paid MRSM school.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would also like to wish you a happy fasting
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and I wish Ramadan Kareem Al-Mubarak to all Members of Parliament who can fast
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and are able to fast as Muslims and other friends.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I do welcome these questions
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and they are with permission,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: very futuristic plans
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: that are being arranged by MARA.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Because the request to enter MRSM is at a level of more than 300 percent of the ability to enter MRSM.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Therefore, we have conducted a feasibility study or with permission, a feasibility study to see that many students who are qualified to enter MRSM in terms of academics
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: but are not eligible in terms of their parents' income.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Especially the T20 and M40 groups,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: where one of the requirements for entry is the priority for the B40 group.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I would like to mention to Yang Berhormat Muar also that there are too many requests from MRSM alumni
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: who have become parents
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: who want their children to enter MRSM
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: but as mentioned,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: their income does not cause their children to be eligible.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: Therefore, without compromise in terms of quality,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: without compromise in terms of academic minimum approval,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: we will open up the widest possible space for the children of MRSM alumni to enter the existing MRSM and not to mention those who are able to bring their children into MRSM
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: which will be created on a paid basis.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: For the information of Yang Berhormat Muar, also in our plan,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: we will not use allocations from the government.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: On the other hand, we will use the private finance initiative ( PFI ) service and we will work with financial institutions for financing.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: In this regard, we must get out of the cocoon and think without a box, not just outside the box to implement
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: and I am confident
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: that this is the new approach of MARA, especially to deal with the problems faced by those who are interested
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: but do not have the opportunity for their children
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: to enter MRSM normally.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: Honorable Muar.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Deputy Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: The commitment so that the government does not use its funds is a good commitment.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: I only have two additional questions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman asked the Prime Minister to state
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: how many cases of sexual offenses against children have been reported, prosecuted and resolved since the Sexual Offenses Against Children Act 2017 was enforced,
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: and what are the government's plans and efforts
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: to combat such cases
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: thus improving the child's criminal justice system.
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: Minister in the Prime Minister's Department ( Institusi Law and Reform )
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you for asking the question.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: For information, from 2018 until January 2028, a total of 5,519 cases have been reported under the Sexual Offenses Against Children Act 2017.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Among the 5,519 cases, a total of 4,713 cases have been resolved
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and a total of 3,060 cases have been charged in court.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: The government is always committed to combating cases of sexual offenses against children.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: In general, the drafting of Act 792 is a very good step
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: in helping the police
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: to carry out investigations and prosecutions in drafting specific charges under Act 792
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: compared to general criminal laws applicable
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: to adults such as the Penal Code and other relevant laws.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: This is because often cases of sexual offenses
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: involving child victims will have such unique cases
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: that are not in cases involving adults.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Therefore, the provisions in Act 792 can provide more accurate and comprehensive protection to children.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Apart from that, the provisions
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: regarding the presumption of the ability and testimony of child witnesses under section 17 and section 18 of Act 792
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: also do help the public prosecutor a lot
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: in obtaining a conviction or a charge under Act 792.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: The provision is based on the basis
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: that child testimony in sexual cases can not always be supported with support evidence due to sexual criminal offenses
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: often occur in closed circumstances.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Therefore, the provision that allows evidence without support for child witnesses under the act in 2017
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: is based on global research and evidence
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: that children have the ability
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: to give accurate evidence on a fact
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: if the method used to ask the child witness
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: is appropriate to the child's thinking.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: The government is also currently in the process
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: of making several amendments to Act 792
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: to improve the existing provisions.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Apart from that, the government will amend the Child Witness Evidence Act 2007
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: to provide for a special hearing for another mechanism under the child witness's testimony
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: that can be taken in the form of video recording
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: so that children do not have to attend trial
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and give authority to the court to prohibit questions
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: that should not be asked to children to ensure that a witness, the child witness can give a more calm, smooth and comfortable statement.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: However, the legal situation alone is not enough to deal with the issue of sexual crimes against children.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: All steps that need to be taken in the process of the criminal justice system for a case of sexual crimes against a child
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: must be child-friendly, with child-friendly permission.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: which requires corroborative evidence to the child's testimony has been removed.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: Meaning, even if he does not swear,
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: even if he does not have the support of the child's testimony being accepted.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: What is the government's view?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: That's right, Honorable Kota Bharu.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Indeed, that's why next week we will hold an engagement session with all Members of Parliament from both sides
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: and also Senators from the National Assembly about the amendment to this act
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: which is included once in the Child Witness Evidence Act 2007.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: What the Honorable mentioned will be done in the second phase
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: because we need to involve it, especially with the Bar Council.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Because of the collaboration issue that the Honorable mentioned, many advocates in our country still have doubts in the terms.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Although what the Honorable Kota Bharu mentioned is true.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: In the world, out there, the element of collaboration is not very used
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: because there is a lot of evidence that supports the child's testimony.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So, that's why this amendment needs to be done in the second phase
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: but next week we will make amendments to the first phase in terms of thermology, addition in the aspect of social media sophistication
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: where children become victims for sexual exploitation with permission.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: We also look at the Evidence Act of the child mentioned by the Honorable.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Indeed, on behalf of this government something that needs to be seen as a challenge.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Azalina Othman Said

edus.text: Your Honor, the session for Minister's Question Time is now over today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I invite Mrs. Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail, Ampang.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail asked the Prime Minister to state the possibility that the Federal Government's decision to move from the single wholesale network model to the dual network resulted in some harm or effects such as international contract default, good governance violations, cyber security risks, surges in financial implications for the government and 5G tariff increases for consumers.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Ampang.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: On May 3, 2023, the government decided to continue with the implementation of 5G and switch from single wholesale network to dual network model due to some justifications, increase competition
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: and end the monopoly elements associated with DNB, offer network diversity
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: and overcome the issue of single failure points in the single wholesale network model
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: and involve existing telecommunications companies so that they can be more comprehensive
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: and guarantee the sustainability of the telecommunications industry ecosystem in Malaysia which has been led by the private sector.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, this transition is a difficult decision
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: because we are under pressure from various parties
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: who want to maintain a network
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: and are not happy with Malaysia's more independent attitude to choose the required network system,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: whether in the west or in the east.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: However, the decision of the Cabinet is finally for the sake of national security and our freedom to choose with strict conditions,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: which is to set the conditions of all telcos using the existing structure DNB network until 80 percent of the network is completed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Then ensure that the connectivity is carried out,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: including in the countryside, inland.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: If this is agreed upon,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: then after using the same facility, telcos that have recorded very good profits have been required to invest so
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: that they guarantee safety not only from the point of view of facilities to all its connectivity people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Secondly, the issue of cyber security through the National Cyber Security Agency which will monitor together.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: The implications for the government are greatly reduced
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: because of the involvement of telcos and the second strict condition is that the price for consumers must be at a low level as we ensure it is set under DNB regulations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Finally, the role of SKMM is because control is very limited now.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Therefore, regulations and laws will be streamlined
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: so that SKMM can control the telco journey more effectively, including two networks after the initial preparation under DNB.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Additional question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Please Honorable Ampang.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Thank you to the Prime Minister for the clear answer.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However,
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if - I want to ask two more questions,
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if the implementation by DNB reaches 80 percent as informed later,
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: will the second network only focus on providing 20 percent coverage remaining.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Is it like that or revamped as a whole?
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, we see that the use of this internet network is quite a conversation on 4G services that we see there are more weaknesses and failures.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My second question, what are the government's steps to ensure that 5G services after DNB is taken over by the provision of telecommunications services reach an optimal quality level?
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Ampang.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: I agree with the attention expressed
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: because our decades of experience with telco is not very encouraging.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: First, connectivity issues.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Secondly, comfort issues for consumers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Thirdly, the issue of costs and payments to consumers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: So, that's why in the strict regulations and conditions controlled by the ministry, especially SKMM, this is taken into account.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: This means that the initial 80 percent journey managed by the government
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: and financed by the government will be jointly borne by DNB and telco.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Secondly, the conditions can not be violated.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: If it violates,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: the aspect of the agreement with this company will be canceled.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Therefore, in the case of 3G and 4G now it is very unsatisfactory
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: because consumers do not benefit
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: even though the company records a very large profit.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: So, this will be monitored by SKMM.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Tasek Gelugor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: thank you Honorable Prime Minister for the explanation.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Yesterday I asked the same question about DNB, thank you for this opportunity.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: First of all, my question is whether we change from single wholesale network to dual wholesale network or two operators covering both, wholesale and retail.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Second, my question is, what is the guarantee that when DNB is handed over to a private company later,
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: then the government can get a valuation as issued by Maybank Investment Bank where this DNB has a value of RM15 billion based on the allocation spectrum for 15 years.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Third Mr. Speaker, lastly, will other monopolies by the government such as electricity, water, highways,
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and even the operation of Sekolah Amanah under the Ministry of Education also be broken with the spirit of breaking this monopoly?
edus.speaker: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Okay, thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Thank you,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: firstly the coverage is both, wholesale and retail.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Secondly, although the rules and agreements with DNB are applicable,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: we have to understand that it is transitioning to the second network not now.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Once followed in one DNB network now so
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: that there is no cost overlap.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: If we break down now,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: it means that the infrastructure that has been completed will be added again.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: So finally now our decision to use the existing infrastructure with the involvement of the existing telco
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: so that it is more transparent.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: The problem in the disputed DNB is also
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: because including the questions raised before in Parliament is not answered, the question of its management and the question of its procurement.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: So now when everyone is involved and monitored by SKMM,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: this matter is identified.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Secondly, about the question of monopoly.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: I agree that the state of this monopoly is not profitable.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Therefore we look for a way - water is not a monopoly, it is under the states.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Both, energy with IPP and with current management seems to be starting to break down.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: The same goes for highways, not everything that the government made before to PLUS.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: So there is competition.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: However, I agree in principle that the practice of monopoly or in the context of dualpolies can not continue, competition should be encouraged that can guarantee comfort to consumers and lower costs.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wan Saiful bin Wan Jan [Tasek Gelugor]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I moved to question number two.

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Therefore, the decision made on the view of the Attorney General

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Otherwise, we make an appeal, the case arose again

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So that's why, we end it by amending all the rules to be clear.

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: For me, this is more clearly a strength.

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: What is weak?

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: If we say, for example, we withdraw the appeal.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Then the situation is still confused now,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: that may be our weakness.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: However, we withdraw to correct it.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Meaning, no court can make decisions in conflict with the decision made now.

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So, all the rules including the KDN that seem weak and give space so that they can be brought to court,

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: that will be canceled and withdrawn.

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: I think there is no problem here.

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: If the friends on the other side take an approach or objective,

addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: is it not appropriate for us to make a decision now?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: This is because the Attorney General thinks, appeal is fine
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: but contrary to the decision of the Malay Rulers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Then, the case arose again, especially because the Attorney General thinks the case is weak.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So it will bring the case again, not finished.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So, for us in the Unity Government now, make a decision, ask for the approval of the kings, all that is contradictory and contrary, the rules we read, those who do not yet know, in all acts and regulations, we cancel
