edus.text: Mr. Khoo Poay Tiong asked the Minister of Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change to state
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: how much subsidy expenditure the government has saved following the adjustment of Imbalance Cost Past-Through ( ICPT ) in January 2023,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and what other measures are being planned by the government to rationalize electricity subsidies in Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: thank you Honorable City of Melaka.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: As we know, electricity tariffs are reviewed every six months with the Imbalance Cost Past-Through ( ICPT ) mechanism taking into account fuel costs and other generation costs for the last six months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In this regard, the cost of ICPT for the period from July to December 2022 is as much as RM16.16 billion equivalent to the 20 sen kilowatt hour surcharge rate that should be released to all users for the period from January to June this year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: However, the government has agreed to maintain a two sen kilowatt hour rebate to all domestic users
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and maintain a 3.7 sen kilowatt hour surcharge to non-domestic users in the low voltage category, low voltage definition B and D as well as the specific question category which is H, H1 and H2 for the period from January 1 to June 30, 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: While other non-domestic users are subject to surcharges at a rate of 20 sen kilowatt hours for the same period.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In this regard, the government has covered an electricity bill subsidy of RM10.76 billion for the period from January 1 to June 30, 2023 to ensure that a total of 9.5 million electricity users representing 99 percent of the total users in Peninsular Malaysia will not be affected by the increase in fuel costs for electricity generation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This means that the government has made a subsidy savings of RM5.4 billion for the period from January 1 to June 30, 2023 where the cost has been released to consumers on a targeted basis.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Although non-domestic users in the medium and high voltage category are subject to an increase of 20 sen ICPT surcharge, the government still covers a subsidy of RM1.93 billion or a seven sen kilowatt hour surcharge
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: so that the actual increase is not released as a whole to the users involved.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For now, the ministry is still examining ICPT surcharge relief options that are reasonable to electricity users in the Peninsula for the period from July 1 to December 31, 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is in line with the government's focus so that subsidies are implemented on a targeted basis based on the amount of electricity consumption according to residence for domestic category users, especially those who use electricity at a high rate.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In addition, the government will also ensure that appropriate surcharges are charged to PMKS, agricultural definition categories users and water operators
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: so that the index of consumer prices and inflation in the country is in a controlled situation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We have a bottom line to ensure that before the national development model is low-cost development or low-cost economy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We want to be a high-value economy
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and we also want to achieve energy efficiency and a transition to renewable energy and only with us really pass-through the cost to high and medium voltage users and large users or T20,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: we can achieve that objective.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: A decision for the next ICPT will be made after the presentation and agreement at the Cabinet level in the near future.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Minister, when the government announces a policy to abolish electricity subsidies for T20, out there the average society has confusion.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: They think everything will be abolished including B40 and M40, they think the electricity tariff has gone up.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Perhaps the Minister can take the opportunity here to explain what the details are for abolishing T20 so that the affected T20 groups know, can adapt and those who are B40 and M40 will not misunderstand.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Second, we can see the government's efforts in helping the people.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Summarize the question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, can the Minister give a comparison between Malaysia in overcoming this global energy crisis compared to regional countries
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and also developed countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Earlier the Minister said about reuse energy.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: So, can the government use this opportunity considering the T20, their subsidies will be abolished.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: We use this platform to encourage this T20 so that they use solar energy
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and we encourage them, incentives so that they can use solar energy.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Finally, it is often said that the IPP Contract is one of the reasons why they get a high profit margin reserve.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Will the government review the tariffs imposed by the IPP.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable City of Melaka.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For information, the announcement made by Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun after chairing MTEN informed that households who use electricity at a high amount will no longer receive subsidies from the government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is after the implementation of the PADU or Main Database system which was also answered by the Prime Minister on May 22, during the PMQ session during the day.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For me, this is a matter of principle that we do not question.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If one house is T20, we assume five, six, seven air-conds, there are dryers with many other equipment
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and the electricity bill is RM500, RM600, RM700 or more, they should not be able to get more subsidies compared to the B40 or M40 groups.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Because it is based on consumption, then those who enjoy more subsidies in terms of ringgit compared to B40 and M40 users.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In terms of principles it is not fair.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, to implement it
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: we need to have a PADU system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Now we only categorize domestic users according to consumption, the use of 300 kilowatts and below, 600 kilowatts to 300 kilowatt hours and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So he does not follow income.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, only with the PADU system which is expected to be completed at the end of the year, we will implement a targeted subsidy for T20 based on income.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Regarding what is mentioned for solar, we agree recently that I and Yang Berhormat Pandan have implemented an announcement about direction
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and also trade for renewable energy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We have stated that out of the 40 percent renewable energy our target in 2050 before, we have increased to 70 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This can be implemented
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: when the energy price is more placed at the market price except for those who need to be protected.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, for that reason we will encourage this solar installation
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and we also expect this to be massive solar installation throughout the country to be done.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If the price of solar can not compete with conventional electricity prices,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: this can not happen.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Finally, about the issue of IPP and reserve margin.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Among the problems that exist now, the government has JPPPET, which we plan electricity use for a period of 20 years, is done every year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: My new JPPPET meeting earlier this year chaired the JPPPET meeting for 2022-2041.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We have already placed when this power plant will end, when the power plant is new, whether it's gas, solar and so on when it will enter the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: `` 1040 Before there was an unsolicited IPP practice, any friend came, a company came, he gave to the Minister to do an IPP.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: There is no in the government's planning but for certain reasons, the Cabinet approved the IPP grant.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Today we have a reserved margin between 40 to 50 percent access energy
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and we pay for this access energy through our electricity bills.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So for that reason, other countries can operate on 15 percent reserved margin
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: but we reach 40-50 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, that's why we have made an announcement that we will stick to our announcement in each JPEG, there is no more unsolicited IPP.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If you come to us,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: please follow what is in the JPEG plan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: It is transparent, we can follow the plan
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: before we can control the excess electricity that is available and our desire even though it has not yet been implemented
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: if we can get early retirement of coal.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is one of the problems that contributes to pollution
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and as obtained by Indonesia in the Just Energy Transition Partnership ( JETP ) their program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If we can do that, it has been touched upon by the Managing Director of Khazanah Nasional in a forum in Qatar recently,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: then we will get energy transition, a faster energy transition.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you for the answer of the Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: I would like to raise the issue of reserved margins mentioned earlier, a very large amount, 40 to 50 percent.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: I think we waste almost every time.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: My question is that we find that there is a request from neighboring countries to buy our energy whether Singapore or South Thailand.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Does the government not intend to look at this so that the reserved margins are not wasted
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and we can generate income from this reserved margin, thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Indeed, we agree with that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: One of the best things for us to do is so that we can sell or trade the electricity in our country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Therefore, the government under the leadership of His Excellency Tambun, we have reversed the band for us to trade Tenaga Boleh Baharu.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: So, this is a big decision
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: because for example I give an example of Singapore talking about making cables all the way to Australia, wanting to make cables all the way to Cambodia, wanting to make cables to Sarawak
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: while Johor is the closest location.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: So, today we can take advantage of it
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: when the government allows through energy exchange for us to sell the energy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Puan Isnaraissah Munirah binti Majilis @ Fakharudy [Kota Belud]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: We are already selling conventional energy, YTL is selling to Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: That is already using our interconnect and there is also Singapore and Malaysia itself we have bought hydro energy from Laos through Thailand.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: It's just that what we need to do for us to really be the center of what one day ASEAN Power Grid says is that we have to upgrade or upgrade our inter-connection.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: We intend to allow the connection between Sarawak and the peninsula proposed
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: when the construction of the Bakun Dam can be realized.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: That's what I think is best for us.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Next, we get Thailand as well,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: it's true that they have a demand for electricity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: We have to upgrade our inter-connect,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: so those steps need to be taken
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: so that we can become a hub for the ASEAN Power Grid.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Kota Belud is one more thing, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Puan Isnaraissah Munirah binti Majilis @ Fakharudy [Kota Belud]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Honorable members, now the session for Minister's Question Time is over today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor. [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Okay, I will invite Kuala Pilah.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Before I invite Kuala Pilah, I want to inform you that during the Minister's Question Time, the Honorable Member must read what the Honorable asked.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Well, I invite Dato' Haji Adnan bin Abu Hassan.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Please Dato' .
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan asked the Minister of Plantation and Commodities to state what steps and initiatives are currently
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and will be implemented by the ministry to help small rubber farmers
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: who are currently facing low rubber prices.
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
everyone

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
everyone

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kuala Pilah.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, first of all the government is aware of the low rubber price challenge faced by smallholders.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Therefore, the government has implemented several initiatives to help small rubber farmers as follows.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: First of all, Rubber Production Incentive ( IPG ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The government is very concerned and listens to the complaints of smallholders,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: especially when they are treated through ministry programs such as the Commodity Track Program.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Therefore, the government and the presentation of the 2024 Budget have agreed to increase the rate of activation price ( PHP ) for IPG from RM2.70 to RM3.00 per kilogram with an allocation of RM400 million.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This increase in incentive rates is expected to ease the burden of smallholders
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: when there is uncertainty in the rubber price level.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: For information, until August 2023, the granting of IPG has benefited 217,705 smallholders with a payment of RM474.54 million.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This IPG program has been implemented since September 2015.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The second is the Latex Production Incentive Rintis Project ( IPL ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The Ministry through LGM implements the Latex Production Incentive Rintis Project which is improved with the granting of incentives as follows.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: First of all, the monthly incentive rate is increased to RM2.00 per kilogram.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This is for 100 percent dry rubber content.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: It used to be RM1.00 for one hundred percent dry rubber content.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The second, the participation incentive payment amounted to RM200 per month for a period of one year.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This means that if before, they produced dry rubber, switching to latex, they would get a remuneration of RM200 per month.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The third, the incentive incentive material rate amounted to RM100 per month in a limited period of one year.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This one, if it has produced latex.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: If they continue to produce latex,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: they will get an additional, every month RM100.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The fourth, the productivity incentive based on annual productivity which achieves the productivity target of RM1,000 for the first cluster,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: which is if he can produce 1,000 to 1,499 kilograms per hectare every year.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: If 1,500 is for the second cluster, this one if he can produce 1,500 on one kilogram per hectare every year.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This effort will involve smallholders selling latex directly to the factory, where the transport cost will be reduced
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: and smallholders will receive better prices.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This pilot project has started in Sungkai, Perak which I myself have launched and God willing,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: will also be implemented in Sabah and Kedah.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This will be implemented by pilot.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The second is the Stimulan Gas Use Rintis Project.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This one was approved as much as RM10 million by MOF which was announced recently in the budget.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This is expected that if they can use this method,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: he will be able to increase the rubber output three times.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: So, this and also the tree life expectancy will be able to be extended up to 25 years
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: and now we are targeting 1,000 hectares of this pilot project.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: If successful, this will be developed.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The fourth is the National Rubber Industry Transformation Program.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This one I have answered many times in Parliament.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: So, I think maybe I can refer back to what this target program means is where we set up in groups with cooperatives and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Participants joined and alhamdulillah, so far there are six entries
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: and we can see that their income increases.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Thank you, okay.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Please Kuala Pilah.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Tan Sri.
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: My additional question is that apart from short-term incentives,
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: what are the long-term measures to help smallholders
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and refer to the trend of rising natural rubber prices these few weeks,
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: what is the reason
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and will this increase in natural rubber prices continue
edus.speaker: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs to state why the government has not yet expressed its firmer stance and actions on conflict issues in Palestine such as urging Benjamin Netanyahu to be brought before the International Criminal Court.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Pasir Mas for the question.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, I believe that since the crisis hit, Malaysia is the country that is the most vocal in fighting for the Palestinian issue in any situation and time.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: In fact,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: if the Honorable Members follow Malaysia's stance lately,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: we have increased the highest level of pressure on the international community not to continue to close their eyes
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and allow the Zionist regime to maharajalela and blindly kill civilians
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: including women, children and the elderly.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Malaysia continues to raise issues of bias by the West in the issue of the tyranny of the Zionist regime
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: without any punitive action.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Is this their behavior that often boasts about being human rights fighters?
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Malaysia's stance has been unraveled very clearly by the Honorable Prime Minister during the Malaysia Bersama Palestin Assembly at Axiata Arena last Tuesday,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: immediately after he returned from a visit to Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Egypt.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Similarly, His Excellency also expressed his stance in several international forums, international meetings including the latest in the GCC Asian meeting in Riyadh.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I believe the Honorable Members have also followed closely what the Honorable Prime Minister conveyed.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The latest UN has approved the application of the OIC and the Arab League
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: supported by Malaysia, Brunei, Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Maldives, Timor-Leste and Vietnam or Timor-Leste `` and Vietnam for an emergency extraordinary meeting at the United Nations on the Palestinian issue.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: It will be chaired by the 78th UNGA President at 10am New York time today.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, touched on the issue of bringing Benjamin Netanyahu to the International Criminal Court or with the permission of the International Criminal Court ( ICC ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I would like to clarify here that issues related to Palestine have actually been brought to the ICC.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For the information of the President, in accordance with the provisions in the Rome Statute, a criminal international case listed in the statute can only be referred to the ICC prosecutor by three parties,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: whether it is a member of the Rome Statute itself, where Malaysia is not a member, the United Nations Security Council or the UN or with the ICC prosecutor's own initiative.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Palestine adopted the Rome Statute in 2015.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Following that, the ICC prosecutor had made an initial examination of the Palestinian situation whether the criteria of the Rome Statute were met to open any investigation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In December 2019, the ICC prosecutor decided that the statutory criteria under the Rome Statute were met to open the investigation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Next, a pre-trial in the chamber was carried out in February 2021 to determine whether the ICC has jurisdiction over the Palestinian situation
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because it involves legal issues and complex territories covering the Gaza Bank, the West Bank and Baitulmuqaddis.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: As a result of the pre-trial in the chamber, the ICC prosecutor announced in March 2021 to open an investigation into the Palestinian situation and alleged crimes committed by the Israeli side since June 13, 2014 without an end period.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Therefore, the Palestinian situation is already in the process of the ICC's investigation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Malaysia will always call and cooperate with OIC member countries as well as countries as thought so that the UN can refer to the issue of Israeli cruelty not only to the ICC but to the International Court of Justice, with the permission of the International Court of Justice.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: On December 30, 2022, the UN adopted a resolution 74/247 requesting that the ICJ give an opinion of advice or with permission, an advisory opinion
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: regarding issues related to Palestine.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In addition, Malaysia participated in submitting a written statement to get an opinion of advice regarding the Palestinian issue that was submitted to the ICJ registrar on July 25, 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable Member Pulai, the number of passengers of the Shuttle Tebrau service between JB Sentral and Woodlands, Singapore has recovered
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and even recorded a very encouraging increase.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: For the year 2023, the average passenger per day was 8,635 people, an increase of seven percent compared to the previous passenger record of COVID-19, which is a total of 8,077 people per day in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: The government has also held discussions with Singapore, through the Malaysia-Singapore Joint Ministerial Committee for Iskandar Malaysia platform
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: to increase the capacity of the Shuttle Tebrau service
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: which includes the increase in the frequency of train operations from 31 trips to 36 trips and the increase in the number of coaches per train operation from four coaches to eight coaches.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: This improvement will offer an increase in the capacity of the number of passengers up to 13,760 people per day.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Currently, Keretapi Tanah Melayu Berhad ( KTMB ) and the Ministry of Transport are still waiting for feedback from the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: ( ICA ), Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Please, Pulai.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you to the Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: KTM Shuttle Tebrau is actually the KTM in the Pulai Parliament.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: It has been more than 100 years of service.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, there have been many contributions there
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and many or many users are made up of workers who commute between Singapore and Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, it has been 100 years
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and previously there have been many contributions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Then it is also important for our position in Johor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, my question is whether KTMB Shuttle Tebrau will continue to operate,
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: after RTS will operate in 2027?
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you to Yang Berhormat Pulai.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: First of all in the bilateral agreement between Malaysia and Singapore to implement the RTS project, one of the conditions that have already been agreed together is that when the RTS service is completed later
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and after the RTS starts operations,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: if I'm not mistaken six months after operating,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: then this Shuttle Tebrau service will be stopped.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: That was the previous agreement between Malaysia and Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: However, I understand that what Yang Berhormat Pulai has desired
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and I myself feel that it is not wrong
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and if we have more connectivity between the two countries and this gives more choice to passengers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: So, therefore the Ministry of Transport will work to negotiate this matter with Singapore so
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: that this service is maintained even after the RTS starts operating.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Please Jerantut.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you to the Minister for answering the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: A very good thing, refreshing
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: when the Minister tells about the increase in trains that will be added to avoid congestion during peak hours.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The question from us is what other initiatives or actions are being taken in collaboration between the Ministry of Transport, immigration, and the Johor State Government for us to reduce congestion during peak hours for our workers who work in Singapore?
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Please, Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you to Yang Berhormat Jerantut.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: First of all, in terms of the addition of the trip and the coach we do work on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, to realize this addition, it does not depend on one side only.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: On our part, especially the KTMB operator is ready.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We have enough coaches to increase that frequency
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: and also increase its capacity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, this is also subject to approval from Singapore who accept passengers
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: because they also have constraints in terms of their immigration in Woodlands.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: So, that's why the trip takes a long time for us to negotiate so that it can be added.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Both in terms of easing the congestion in the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Indeed, that is something that is very given attention by the government and a Special Cabinet Committee chaired by the Honorable Petra Jaya,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: also took various steps to reduce the congestion in the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We try to see various ways and coordination between various agencies to reduce the time required for us to cross the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Among the things I think that have already been taken into account and taken action.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: For example, in terms of the counter or Touch 'n Go touch point by paying the road charge for entry from Singapore has already been consolidated.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: So, the two counters are consolidated
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: and that of course can also save some time for cars from Singapore to enter Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, there are many other ways.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We will try to add motorcycle lanes,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: also add counters and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Also ensure that the immigration counters are always fully optimized.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, whatever we feel that the Johor Causeway is not easy for us to solve in terms of congestion and in terms of long-term time is that we expect that when the RTS project is completed,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: it can disperse a little congestion in the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We will also see various other ways to increase connectivity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: For example, there is also a proposal to have ferry services between the two Malaysia and Singapore, especially from Johor Bahru to Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Good, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Now the session for Minister's Question Time is over today.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you. Secretary. [ Time Session for Minister's Questions ends ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Honorable members, before I invite the Honorable Member to ask, I would like to inform you that today all MQTs will be answered by the Honorable Deputy Prime Minister, the Member of Parliament for Petrajaya.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Article 43(3),
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Federal Constitution, the Cabinet must be responsible together, collectively to Parliament.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Therefore, I allow the Honorable Deputy Prime Minister to answer all three MQT questions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: For that, I invite Mrs. Young Syefura binti Othman, Honorable Bentong.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: To Man Kedah stall to buy bread, Posted with lontong dishes, Assalamualaikum and good morning, From me representing Bentong.
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman asked the Prime Minister to state the latest UNESCO data
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: by mentioning that only five percent of Malaysian youth are involved in the field of TVET.
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: To what extent is the UNESCO findings resolution
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: compared to the enrollment data
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and what are the government's new strategies and policies
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: to improve the effectiveness of TVET programs?
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman ask the Prime Minister to state the latest UNESCO data through the International Center for Technical and Vocational Education and Training mentioning
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: that only five percent of Malaysian youth are involved in the field of TVET.
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: To what extent are the UNESCO findings resolutions
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: compared to the enrollment data
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and what are the government's new strategies and policies
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: to improve the effectiveness of TVET programs?
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr Speaker.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: First of all, I would like to record that the Prime Minister is on a working visit abroad, official affairs.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Therefore, I represent him today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: For the information of the honorable House, the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Program or in short TVET in this country is implemented
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and managed across 12 ministries and involves the participation of public skills training institutions providers or for short ILKA and private skills training institutions ( ILKS ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: There are a total of 1,295 TVET institutions including ILKA and ILKS that are currently operating by offering TVET programs that are suitable for the target group set.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Referring to the latest UNESCO data stating that only five percent of Malaysian youth are involved in the field of TVET, this statement is based on the involvement of youth between the ages of 15 and 24 years.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: This takes into account the country's youth population in the same age range, totaling as many as six million people based on statistics from the Department of Statistics Malaysia or DOSM.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: The data stated by UNESCO is in line with enrollment statistics for 2021 showing that the number of youth in the same age category participating in the TVET program is 360,000 people.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: For the information of the honorable House, the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Council (MyTVET) was established on 18 December 2020
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and acted as the highest body to make decisions related to the country's TVET direction where its membership is across all ministries, TVET providers and various related stakeholders.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Under the Unity Government, MyTVET in the country on 7 February 2023 discussed appropriate measures that can be taken by the government for improvements to the country's TVET ecosystem through strategic cooperation with government-related companies (GLCs)
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and also private companies.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: As a quick win step, the implementation of TVET program collaboration specifically according to the field at ILKA with private companies or GLCs will be implemented immediately through the signing of the MOA memorandum of agreement.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Among the proposed skills areas are automation, oil and gas, hospitality
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and also air cooling and conditioning technology.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Targeted this year, 50 MOAs will be signed as announced in the Budget on 24 February 2023.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: In the near term, 10 MOAs with GLCs and private companies will be finalized for the implementation of the high-impact TVET program.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: This MOA will act as a master collaboration platform between GLCs and also private companies and the government.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please, Honorable Bentong.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Additional questions.
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: What is the government's initiative to enhance youth in this field of TVET, especially youth in rural areas and Orang Asli youth?
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Yang Berhormat Bentong who is also concerned about our rural areas
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and also our Orang Asli.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Indeed, this TVET program includes all
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: including in the city
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and also in the countryside.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: As mentioned earlier, the Ministry of Human Resources, the Ministry of Rural and Regional Development, the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Higher Education, all hold programs related to TVET.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: For Orang Asli, for example, there is already a special program, especially implemented jointly with the Perak Orang Asli Association where ILP in Ipoh has already held this program.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: We need to give more awareness to rural residents
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and also Orang Asli to be involved together and need to involve parents so that they will be able to survive in this TVET training
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: and they will be given training.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
