edus.text: That is also the ministry is considering.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Perhaps one of the constraints is in terms of the starting fee payment of RM800.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Maybe if we can consider this,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: help them, maybe more youth, especially the Orang Asli will be able to be involved in this TVET training.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Parit Buntar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please, Honorable Parit Buntar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker and thank you Honorable Deputy Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I would like to suggest, does the government intend to add or organize short-term TVET programs to the youth in this country
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: by providing allocations to the agencies responsible in each state
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: because I have a little experience
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: when managing a government agency to organize short-term programs for young people
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and get a good response.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: If we do the TVET program,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: six months, a year, two years, three years they are not interested.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: However, young people who graduate from SPM who do not have the opportunity to continue their studies at the diploma and certification level
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: but they are interested
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: if we organize short-term programs, three months and so on.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: So, does the government intend to organize the program?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Okay, alright.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Parit Buntar.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: Indeed, this program is indeed implemented
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: and is ongoing either by GIATMARA, by CIDB through their training centers and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: There is a short-term course where they can get a certificate, even given an allowance for them to follow this short-term course.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: Therefore, this TVET is lifelong learning.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: We should implement the existing long-term program as well, which may want to take a diploma or even a degree
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: but there are also those who are just to take a certificate,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: there are also those who are only to get basic technical training.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: This is ongoing
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: and we will continue from the various training centers that are currently running in our country.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Haji Mohd Misbahul Munir bin Masduki [Parit Buntar]

edus.text: Now I invite the Honorable Dato’ Saifuddin bin Abdullah, Indera Mahkota.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Dato 'Sri Saifuddin Abdullah asked the Prime Minister to state
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: whether the government intends to propose to this House specific details related to comprehensive reforms to the country's systems and institutions, including parliamentary reforms and continue the reform initiatives that have been worked on before
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and whether the government will propose an inclusive consultation process to implement the reform agenda.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, as a whole and to ensure the implementation of a comprehensive institutional reform initiative, a special team on institutional reform
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: chaired by the Honorable Minister in the Prime Minister's Department ( Laws and Institutional Reform ) was established in January 2023 to examine, study and propose institutional reforms including the mechanism for the implementation of the reform for the consideration of the Cabinet.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: An institutional reform workshop was held on 17 January 2023 involving government agencies and civil society organizations ( CSO ) groups as well as non-governmental organizations ( NGOs ) that focus on legal reform and national institutions.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: A series of engagements with ministries, departments, interested agencies will continue to finalize the proposed institutional reform that wants to be implemented
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: before being presented to the Cabinet.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: In 2018, an Institutional Reform Committee or Institutional Reform Committee (IRC) was established to assist the Government Advisory Council or Council of Eminent Persons
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: which plays a role in advising the government in the fields of economy, finance and others during the first 100 days of the government's transition.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: A final report was prepared
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: and submitted to the government.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: However, this final report was not published to the public
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: because it was bound by the Official Secrets Act 1972.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: In addition, the government also intends to create an election system and management based on democratic principles accepted by all parties as free, fair and transparent.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Therefore, the Electoral Reform Committee (ERC) has been established since 2018 to examine the proposed improvement of the election system and management in Malaysia with all stakeholders.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Further, a Special Cabinet Committee was created in 2022
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: to examine the ERC recommendations for the consideration of the Cabinet in the near future.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: The government is also committed to the implementation of Parliament's institutional reforms by re-establishing Parliament's services
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: to realize the desire for separation of powers between the legislature and the executive body.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: At this point, the government is studying the need to enact the Parliamentary Services Act to make Parliament's services separate from the public service.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Some policy matters regarding the drafting of the Parliamentary Services Act will be finalized
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: before being presented in the Cabinet Meeting.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: At the same time, in order to adapt to the current environment and situation,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: the government is also examining to amend the Parliament Council (Privileges and Powers) Act 1952 [Act 347].
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Among the things that need to be noted is the fine rate provided in this act which has never been amended
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: since it was enacted in 1952
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: and also outdated terms and terms that need to be amended so
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: that it is relevant to the current situation.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: I ask for a little more time.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Next, the addition and amendment to the Whistleblower Protection Act 2010 [Act 711] is also being implemented to empower the act
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: and realize the vision of the National Anti-Corruption Plan (NACP) 2019-2023 to create a corruption-free country.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: The implementation of improvements takes into account the views and inputs of a series of engagements with stakeholders including the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: and also the Government Accountability Project.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: The Unity Government takes this institutional reform agenda seriously and will take thorough action to realize this agenda.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: The government will ensure that any reform implemented will take into account the views of all interested parties.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Indera Mahkota.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Thank you for the comprehensive answer
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and I assure you that we on this side are the same and the same page in us succeeds in reform.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: I want to ask a low-hanging fruit
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: which is the University and University College Act.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Section 15
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: which gives political freedom to the students was amended not when His Excellency Tambun was Deputy Prime Minister
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: but when His Excellency Pekan was Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: The minister was responsible
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and I worked together at that time.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: I want to record that there are two Members of Parliament now who have not been Members of Parliament yet
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: but are also involved in the process, the Honorable Setiawangsa and the Honorable Bangi.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Also, former Members of Parliament Mrs. Nurul Izzah Anwar and Mr. Tony Pua and the President of the Bar Council at that time, now Dato' Lee Chin Wei.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: The question is that in the Pakatan Harapan manifesto, AUKU wants to be abolished
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: but my friend the Honorable Minister of KPT answered a little differently.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: This is a low-hanging fruit that is easy, which should be amended immediately
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: because the work to replace AUKU which is now that the Honorable Minister understands that matter has already started in his time.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Honorable Indera Mahkota, the question is ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: If possible, would it be abolished and how.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Indera Mahkota.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: My friend when he was in the government at one point in the past.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: In fact, at our level even once when we talk about existing policies and legislation, we really have to take into account many things
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: and it is certain that what is proposed will be brought through a normal process and get input from all interested parties - does it need to be reviewed, reviewed or improved.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: That depends on whatever finding will be carried out through engagement from various parties.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Well, I move to ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Second question.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Additional question.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Is there anything else?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: There is.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Okay, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to ask.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I accept the comprehensive reforms made by the government.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: However, is the government aware that when we are many of the Members of Parliament in the opposition, we have suggested to create another Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: This is to give space to the opposition to be involved in administration.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Second, it eases the work of the Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Will it be taken into account
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and what time limits have the government determined so that all these reforms can be expedited?
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Honorable Minister?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Dear Ipoh Barat, thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: This matter has also been discussed by the previous government,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: but it can not be implemented.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: In fact, the meeting of the Chief Whip of the government and also the opposition - Mr. Yang di-Pertua himself has also discussed this matter
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: but it has to go through the process.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: This means that discussions at the level of the stakeholders will finally be brought to the Cabinet for us to detail
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: and be considered.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: So, the direction is to go - whatever agreement we will announce later.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Thank you, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Time period, time period?
edus.speaker: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: I can not state the time period
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: because it has to go through the process.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: When the process has been brought,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: then we can decide whether it must be there or not.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]
Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: So, the decision depends on the engagement that will be made by all stakeholders, including by the President himself.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan M. Kulasegaran a/l Murugeson [Ipoh Barat]

edus.text: For additional information, we have already allowed Members of Parliament from the opposition to become Speakers to the Special Chamber recently.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: We have already started. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Oscar Ling Chai Yew asked the Prime Minister to state that the congestion of government hospitals at this point is becoming increasingly worrying where the people do not receive appropriate medical and health services
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: while having to wait a long time to obtain health services from government hospitals.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: What are the government's measures in improving the quality of national health services?
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Sibu.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: This is a question that is always close to the hearts of all representatives of the people.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Thank you to Yang Berhormat Sibu for bringing this issue.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: In my opinion, for the information of the Honorable and the entire Member of the House of Representatives,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: if we look at why there is congestion in the hospital — even though the government has made a lot of effort, how many new hospitals have been built, old hospitals have been upgraded, health clinics, rural clinics have all increased
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: but there is still congestion.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So this congestion, in my opinion, is the first reason to show that our health system, by all health officials from doctors, nurses and all ministries involved in healthcare, has improved.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: When it improves, the people's confidence to go to the hospital,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: because good health services will definitely refer to government hospitals.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Second,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: because our hospitals provide services that can be said to be almost free.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: It is very cheap
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: if we compare it with private hospital services.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Therefore, this government hospital is the focus.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: That's why
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: if we look at it,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: the government has also increased the number of doctors, all nurses have increased but are still facing congestion.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So, for that reason, the government has already established a Special Task Force for Public Sector Reform (STAR) chaired by Tan Sri KSN
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and is made up of various agencies.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Not only the Ministry of Health, but various ministry agencies and so on where they discuss sit down to see what other improvements can be made.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: For that, they implement programs in a short-term, mid-term and long-term manner where cooperation with the private sectors, private hospitals and also medical practitioners, private clinics to share, where some patients who may not face critical diseases will be able to get medicine in private clinics.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Likewise those who come especially during odd hours from 6 to 12 pm,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: if not how much is where they can be sent to a nearby health clinic, a district clinic where their operating hours will be extended until 12 pm.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: This is a short-term step
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and also a moderate step is implemented.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: As announced in the recent budget, the Madani Medical Scheme has also been allocated specifically, where allocations will be given for our people to go to see private general medical practitioners (GPs) to do non-critical treatment
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: or normal fever and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So, the main reason is, Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: why are hospitals still congested?
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Maybe the quality of our services has improved
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: but at the same time gives the impression that do we in Malaysia not practice a healthy living culture
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and for that reason, too many have to refer to doctors, sick fevers and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So that's why, the emphasis by the Ministry of Health is also to bring or promote a healthy living culture.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: This is very important as a preventive measure that we should focus on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: This is where I think the role of all Members of Parliament for us to carry out programs together with the Ministry of Health, doctors to give awareness to practice this healthy living culture among our people,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: so that we don't have to go to the hospital, only critical patients and so on,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: so that our hospitals will not be burdened with us handling too many health cases that ultimately harm the country in terms of financial position
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and harm our own people as well.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: So, that should be our focus.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Honorable Sibu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Thank you for the good answer.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Indeed, we do not deny that government hospitals do provide good services to our people.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: However, we have a few things I would like to inform the ministry that specialist doctor services are not available in all hospitals, especially in local hospitals
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and they are only available in regional hospitals.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: This is also one of the reasons why many patients go to regional areas to get specialist doctor services
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: because their area does not have such services.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: So, I want to ask the government.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Does the government intend to establish a heart unit and cancer unit at Sibu Hospital and Miri Hospital?
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: This is also one in the Pakatan Harapan manifesto that we will upgrade Sibu Hospital and Miri Hospital as regional hospitals.
edus.speaker: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Sibu.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: As I said earlier, the government's ability to create hospitals
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and provide limited specialists in terms of -
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: even if we have built a hospital, the possibility of getting a specialist who wants to serve
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: is also a challenge.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Therefore, what we should focus on, what has been discussed in the STAR committee earlier is for us to collaborate with private hospitals that also have expertise where we can share in terms of service and also in terms of - where there has actually been discussions, consultations with private hospitals and also medical associations.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: I thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Where they have agreed to be involved together in taking care of the health of our people holistically.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: The meaning of the government, private and private practitioners and the government are also involved together in taking care of the health of our people where if they come
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and the government hospital can not give due to the long queue, they will be handed over to private hospitals where certain fees have already been negotiated
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: and agreed upon.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: If this can be implemented,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: it is possible that it can help in the short and medium term
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: while we build more hospitals based on districts, based on divisions or based on states that require certain expertise.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Meanwhile, we work with the private parties.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Tuan Oscar Ling Chai Yew [Sibu]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Peace be upon you.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I would like to get an explanation regarding the status of the teaching hospital at Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM).
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: What is the latest status
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and has the government recognized this USIM as an teaching hospital?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: This may be a bit out of the line
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: and this question is quite specific.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: I will make a written answer to this rather specific question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Good, thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Honorable members, the session for Minister's Question Time is now over today.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: That's it, thank you and we are moving on to the next questions and questions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Honorable Member, there is an issue raised by the Honorable Jelutong two to three days ago
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and I have already met with the Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: For that, I ask the Honorable Kubang Kerian to get up
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: and give an explanation.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: For the information of the honorable House, I have already held a meeting with Mr. Speaker and I have given an explanation regarding some mistakes that occur.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I think we don't need to extend this matter
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: because we have many important issues.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: So, I think
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: if there is a mistake,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I apologize
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and we continue to an agenda that is more important for the benefit of the people.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Good, thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: This is the spirit we have.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: I have met with Yang Berhormat Kubang Kerian and our understanding is different
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but what has been mentioned by Yang Berhormat Kubang Kerian has already been informed to me.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and greetings.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Let's start this morning Minister's Question Time by inviting Datuk Seri Haji 'Jamaluddin' bin Haji Alias, Jelebu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: 'Jalaluddin' , Mr. Chairman is not 'Jamaludin' .
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I'm afraid of people's mistakes later.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Jalaluddin, forgive me.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: : Jalaluddin, yes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias asked the Prime Minister to state about the latest approach and progress of the implementation of the Unity Government to holistically and effectively eradicate poverty in order to develop a country and civil society that will be an example in the region.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, thank you to Yang Berhormat Jelebu for being more positive in supporting the idea of shady poverty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: This is continuation of the initial steps,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: including the eKasih system collecting poverty databases under the ICU, Prime Minister's Department.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: As of March 15, 2023, the number identified was 123,243 heads of hard poor households had been registered.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Although I chose to put 130,000 people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: because it is possible that this number will increase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Among the coordinated efforts, including the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ),
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: the Donation of Rahmah Cash ( STR ) to 400,000 people who are easily affected.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: The entire incentive assistance subsidy in this entire framework reaches RM64 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: This includes the concept of Rahmah Fungery.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: A total of RM750 million has been allocated for the purpose of IPR with three initiatives that have been announced by the Minister of Economy recently, INTAN, INSAN and IKHSAN.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Then there are more besides the Farmers' Entrepreneur Initiative, the Food Entrepreneur Initiative and the Service Operator Initiative.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Some other steps include efforts to facilitate the appointment of workers, provide equipment and equipment
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: and provide additional allowance assistance to participants.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: The municipal council submitted the names of the participants so
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: that they can be treated directly.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: These are only some simplifying methods
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: and STRs are given to almost 9 million recipients.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: I develop this
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: because it covers the amount called hard poverty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Since all the departments and ministries involved are deployed, I am confident that we can handle the 130,000 heads of households this year as well, God willing.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Jelebu.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I looked into the answer from His Excellency Tambun earlier,
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but what I understand is that the People's Income Initiative ( IPR ) is targeting 100,000.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What was conveyed earlier, I am a bit confused
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: whether 125,000 is that the current IPR target achievement that can provide income to poor households
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also B40 of RM2,000 per month?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, my question is about performance or for screening to these IPR participants.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Since we are aware, applications through websites and portals to allow them to be included in this IPR group.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Filtering and leakage to ensure that those who have been selected are truly eligible to receive this help.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I agree with the remarks of Yang Berhormat Jelebu.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Because of the eKasih Report alone,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: before the IPR, there were several figures that were disputed by the setting.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: I- we can not guarantee that 100 percent of the reported amount is truly entitled, including in the category of extreme poverty. '' 1010
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]
everyone

edus.text: However, the addition of this IPR program is because within one month, more than 22,000 people have already registered.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: This is a development that for me is positive
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: because when he registers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: the check method is more effective.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: So if the action is like that, like this, this March year the number is 123,000.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: That's the number of studies done.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: However, I deliberately added to 130,000
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: because I was worried, afraid that there would be some new numbers that were not included throughout this year.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: So for this year, even though it is called 123,000, I say 130,000.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Seri Jalaluddin bin Alias [Jelebu]

edus.text: Yes, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: What is the target that has been placed by the government for every three months in the process of reducing poverty this year?
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: For the first three months, namely April to June.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Both are July to September.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Finally is October to December.
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What mechanism is used to measure the achievement?
edus.speaker: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: The additional allocation that I have announced is phase 1 of STR
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: which was implemented on January 17.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: That involves 8.7 million recipients amounting to RM1.67 billion.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: That's the first phase.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: The second phase of STR was implemented on April 5, God willing, which is in the middle of Ramadan.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: So if we look, as of March 28, an additional 574,886 new applications have been received.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: So if we follow phase 1, phase 2 of April
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: and I believe that in August or October we will give the following developments at the latest.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: Meaning, the channel reaches directly for a large amount
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: and makes it easier for us to solve this problem of extreme poverty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: This category of extreme poverty can be added twice.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: First, through STR and secondly, the IPR initiative.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Idris bin Ahmad [Bagan Serai]

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Question number two, Honorable Masjid Tanah, Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin asked the Prime Minister to state the government's willingness to implement a recommendation from Transparency International Malaysia ( TI-M ) for the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission ( MACC ) to be placed under the jurisdiction of Parliament and no longer under the Prime Minister's Department to ensure that the agency's check and balance process is more independent and transparent thus increasing the level of trust and confidence in the public towards the MACC.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: I see Yang Berhormat Masjid Tanah working hard now
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: because this time the fourth week was submitted,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: that's why I included it even though there are other questions by the opposition.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: However, due to his persistence, he repeated this question four times in a row.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Well, follow the rules and legislation now,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: the MACC is an independent body.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So that's why when I take over, I don't choose to change the MACC Chief Commissioner
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: who has been appointed by Yang Berhormat Pagoh not to create a perception that a new Prime Minister will appoint a new MACC Chief.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Therefore I maintain.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: The provisions of the law now guarantee the freedom of the MACC
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: and are not subject to the instructions of the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So the proposal presented to strengthen his position, then in the current rules there is a Special Committee on Corruption, the Anti-Corruption Advisory Board, the Complaints Committee, the Operations Evaluation Panel and the Consultation and Anti-Corruption Panel.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So that's why,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: if it is raised
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: and there is indeed a study so far
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: because the former Prime Minister has also taken several initiatives to negotiate and weigh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So I have no problem weighing the Transparency International and others recommendations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: I don't think we should make changes solely with this recommendation.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: We also have to be submitted to the Special Select Committee of Parliament to examine so that the MACC's capabilities will be improved
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: and there are no constraints and interventions that are feared will affect the implementation efforts to combat corruption which I consider to be systemic in our country.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Thank you His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The country of His Excellency Tambun is so serious in eradicating corruption as in our Hope Deal page 37
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: regarding stating that the MACC Chief Commissioner's nomination needs to be reviewed by the bipartisan Parliamentary Special Select Committee to guarantee the appointment of a neutral candidate without protecting any party.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So the question and coincidentally, it is heard that the MACC Chief Commissioner will end in a few months.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My question is, can the Honorable Prime Minister guarantee that the new appointment or extension of the Chief Commissioner's contract will now be brought to the Special Committee of Parliament immediately to be discussed?
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Otherwise, will this not give the impression that the Prime Minister's commitment to this reform agenda is no longer there,
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: even if the appointment is made by His Excellency Tambun as Prime Minister will further strengthen the people's assumption that there is a deal that is being arranged by the Prime Minister?
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Masjid Tanah.
