edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: First, I would like to explain the appointment of the MACC Chief Commissioner by Yang Berhormat Pagoh, this one by Yang Berhormat Pagoh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: It must be clear and certified as a person who is Wibawa and independent by Yang Berhormat Pagoh.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: The question now is,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: if there is a new appointment or extension,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: what is the new method imposed?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: It depends on the progress made by Parliament.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: If the process mechanism as decided, proposed by TI and other bodies, is examined by of course the Attorney General's Department and government agencies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Then, transferred to the Select Committee and this process was time.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: So, I have no problem with the process at all
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: but the process should be respected.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Datuk Wira Mas Ermieyati binti Samsudin [Masjid Tanah]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Damansara.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to make a reference to a statement
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: issued by number two from the MACC ( MACC ) yesterday, Ahmad Khusairi Yahya, which was widely reported in the media for the attention of His Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: He said, '' The level of corruption involving enforcement personnel '' Mr. Speaker, '' at the country's frontline is becoming chronic and worrisome ''.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: This is what is reported.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, although what is mentioned there brings special and specific reference to Immigration, I think Honorable Prime Minister, we know that this problem exists in all enforcement or implementation units that exist in this country, including MACC officers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: The Honorable Prime Minister still remembers that when we were in the opposition, we had already raised the feeling that it was necessary for an independent investigation system or mechanism to be created to investigate complaints against especially MACC officers
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also MACC top officials
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when there was a complaint regarding abuse of power.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I heard what the Honorable Prime Minister mentioned earlier where we refer back to the committees that exist in the MACC for a specific purpose
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: but that's the problem.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Your Honor, we can not have a situation where when there is a complaint, the highest MACC ( MACC ) officers are investigated by the MACC itself
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because he is the person who leads the MACC and the MACC also has the right to investigate the police as well.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, there we can see that pressure can be brought.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: There is no freedom
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and that's what we mentioned
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when we were in the opposition before.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So the question now, how do we show or change the mechanism, where there is a complaint.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We still remember complaints made against the MACC chief at that time,
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when investigated internally.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We say that is not correct, not enough
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because we don't know whether or not the investigation is what is called independent or independent.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, my question to the Prime Minister this morning, move forward, what steps will be taken by the government to make sure that
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if there is a complaint, especially regarding the highest MACC officers, which does exist a lot.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: How will we make sure that the investigation is carried out by the independent party
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also the Parliament has the power to ask, inquire, investigate again, make questions regarding what is called the investigations
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: after the investigations have already been completed, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If I get an answer, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: I still remember that stance did not budge.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: That's why,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: when it comes to connection, not only MACC, police, immigration, customs, enforcement bodies,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: when there are allegations or any charges,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: then the body established is an internal body to investigate
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: and this is disputed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Therefore, for the police to be proposed by IPCMC
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: but that is questioned
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: because why it is only directed at the police.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: So, now I have asked the Attorney General to review the initial proposal so that there is a mechanism for all enforcement bodies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: If there are special charges against MACC, immigration, customs, police officers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: then there is an independent body,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: in the form of whether my commission is not yet certain,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: but there has already been instructions to the Attorney General's Department to submit a proposal so that these enforcement bodies do not investigate themselves
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: but there is another independent body that will investigate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: I don't think this is very difficult
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: because there is an initial proposal.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: I just want to emphasize here when the IPCMC issue arises, what the police are arguing about is why it is specifically aimed at them even though the problem should involve all enforcement agencies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: So, in my opinion this is a better proposal
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: which is an independent body that can take action to investigate, take action against all complaints or accusations against enforcement bodies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: This includes me re-explaining, police, MACC, customs, immigration and others related.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, you can add one question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: An important issue.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Sorry.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: We have ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Just one, okay?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Me, okay.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: thank you Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I congratulate the Prime Minister for continuing to fight corruption.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, I would like to suggest to the Prime Minister that we have to deal with the problem of corruption in its fundamentals, basically corruption at the political level, which is whether the Prime Minister wants to continue the proposal
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: to develop political funding laws, as happened to the Honorable Pagoh and the Honorable Tasek Gelugor?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We should have political funding laws.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Maybe political funding by the state, political funding by the state.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I request an explanation and explanation from the Prime Minister,
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: when will this effort be implemented?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
Tuan Gobind Singh Deo [Damansara]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Bayan Baru.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The initial proposal about political funding is still at the level of the Minister who is responsible for the legal issue.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Basically we agree,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: but because it was touched on the question of Yang Berhormat Pagoh earlier,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: it is not accurate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: This is not a matter of political funding.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: That is the charge
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: if you look at it is related to the contract given.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: A party that gets money - now the law is missed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: However, when it comes to the party getting money as a result of the contract given, it means that
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: if I give a contract to the company' A' ,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: the company' A' donates to my party, that is included in the category of corruption.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: So it should be distinguished. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
everyone

edus.text: This is because, many are confusing this issue
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: as if the party can accept it.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: That's right.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: In the current state of law, the party can accept it,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: but if I approve or relate to approving one company, how many hundred million,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: then he donates to my party or my personal account or my personal company.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: We want to say that the act of cruelty is unreasonable.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: It means we want to defend corruption.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: This is the problem.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Okay, I invite the Honorable Mr. Chiew Choon Man, Miri.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: Tuan Chiew Choon Man asked the Prime Minister to state the steps taken in an effort to achieve transitional justice at the same time uphold the rule of law in high-profile cases
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: involving politicians such as Pandora Papers, Panama Papers, former Gombak Member of Parliament or politicians from any party.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I can not answer
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: even if there is information about the previous actions where there are certain instructions.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: However, since I took over, I have taken a comprehensive approach.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: Whoever has a case, who is involved, is an enforcement body, whether the Royal Malaysian Police or MACC refer to the Attorney General's Department, the Attorney General's Department decided to prosecute.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: That's their decision and they should answer.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: The question
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: associated for example with Pandora and Panama Papers, indeed everything is related, even though hundreds according to MACC were addressed to several big cases before.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: However, as the President is well aware, these cases involve people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: who are capable, have large funds and have sophisticated ways.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: If we learn about what happened about Pandora Papers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: there are for example companies in Singapore, accounting firms, PR firms that will try from the beginning to protect works and practices that are considered to be in conflict with the law.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: But the main thing is for us,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: what is the problem - the problem is a trend where political figures or businessmen run away so much money
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: and are kept in offshore centers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: We can identify not only from the Panama Papers Report which is not absolute
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: because it should be investigated
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: but must involve Bank Negara Malaysia, the Inland Revenue Board, the Trade Investigation Division, commercial crime and the IRB.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: So, if these four agencies work that they continue to do.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: The other case called Gombak Member of Parliament
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: is the action of the Attorney General's Department, not the actions of the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Miri.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: Thank you to the answer of His Excellency Tambun.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My next question is in order to uphold the rule of law, is the government ready
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and will in the near future implement the separation of the position
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and role of the prosecutor from the Attorney General to strengthen the freedom of the prosecutor
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and avoid any speculation or accusations that there is a selective prosecution of any politician and at the same time can prevent government institutions from being misused.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: His Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, this proposal has already been studied
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: and there is a proposal to separate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: This matter is a bit complicated.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: I remember it took time.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: In principle, many agree to be separated
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: but at the implementation stage we are careful
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: because in terms of the impact of the financial implications
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: it is estimated to be more than RM300 million additional.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Chiew Choon Man [Miri]

edus.text: However, I agree that it is not the main consideration.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Tuan Lim Guan Eng asked the Minister of Defense to state Malaysia's position following the AUKUS defense alliance where Australia will buy eight nuclear war submarines worth AUD368 billion and the impact on the security of ASEAN countries based on the Zone of Peace Freedom and Neutrality or ZOPFAN and whether 8 nuclear war submarines will be allowed to operate in the waters of ASEAN countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I have to give this question for the answer.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I don't want to say off the cuff afraid that there will be a wrong word that I use
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: because this involves the issue of the relationship of many countries and also security.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: I request permission for me to read the answer.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, on 13 March 2023 recently, the Prime Minister of Australia, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and the President of the United States announced the progress status of the implementation of the AUKUS three-way security agreement.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Before the announcement was made, the Commander of the Australian Armed Forces who is the special envoy of the Prime Minister of Australia came to the office to meet with me, giving an explanation on 9 March 2023 that the development of eight nuclear-powered submarines only uses nuclear-powered engines
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: and will not be equipped with nuclear weapons in line with Australia's commitment under the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons ( NPT ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This explanation was followed by a telephone call from the United States Secretary of Defense on 10 March 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Finally, recently the meeting session of the Minister of State at the United Kingdom's Ministry of Defense on 28 March 2023 came to the MINDEF office.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: During the information session Mr. Speaker, I have explained that Malaysia's stance and principles in relation to AUKUS are permanent and unchanged.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Where, Malaysia urges all relevant parties whether inside or outside of AUKUS to respect each other and fully comply with the existing national legal and international legislation instruments, especially in relation to the operation of nuclear-powered submarines in the country's waters.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This includes instruments under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea ( UNCLOS ),
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: the Southeast Asian Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone Agreement or with the permission of Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone ( SEANWFZ )
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: and the ASEAN Declaration as Zone of Peace, Freedom and Neutrality ( ZOPFAN ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: As a member of ASEAN Mr. Speaker, Malaysia holds the principle to maintain ASEAN as a Safe, Free, and Exceptive Zone.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This includes issues related to the acceleration of nuclear weapons, the prevention of nuclear proliferation, and the use of nuclear technology peacefully.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: In order to ensure the safety and sovereignty of the country and stability in the region remains preserved, Malaysia urges all parties whether inside or outside of this AUKUS alliance to not carry out any provocative activities that can interfere with order and security in the region.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: However, Malaysia always respects the rights of all countries to improve their respective defense capabilities or their respective capacity building, taking into account their respective wishes and interests.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, based on the international law of UNCLOS 1982 which reads, any ship or aircraft is given freedom of navigation or flight or freedom of navigation or overflight in the last sea or in an exclusive economic zone in any country but subject.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: The activity must comply with the rules and laws of coastal countries as long as it is not against UNCLOS 1982.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: `` 1010 UNCLOS 1982 also states that any submarine that passes through other countries' regions must always be on the surface of the water.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: It can not dive, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: It must pass on the surface of the water and this rule applies in our country as well as other persisiran countries in Southeast Asia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Even so, if there is a foreign submarine, whether conventional or nuclear power that wants to sail under the surface of the water in the country's waters,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: the Navy of the foreign country he wants to travel must submit an application to the Royal Malaysian Navy first through a diplomatic note to obtain special approval.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This rule also applies if there is a submarine or warship that wants to enter any port in our country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Honorable Bagan.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Does the Honorable Minister plan to hold a meeting with all ASEAN Defense Ministers so that if we agree more effectively to urge all external powers?
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Don't play nuclear and nuclear weapons in the ASEAN region

addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: but now Your Honor, the Police Psychological Health and Welfare Screening Study is ongoing in collaboration with USIM from January to June this year under the police R & D secretariat.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: Then, in 2022 there has already been a complete study involving almost 26,000 police officers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: Of all this, we have a positive emotional, negative emotional impact on him,
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: and that provides guidance before we put him on one task.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: Although I emphasize that figure is small, low and isolated, the police and the KDN are not at a cost of one life.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: The idea to ensure that incidents like this do not happen again is our priority.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Wan Hassan bin Mohd Ramli [Dungun]

edus.text: City of Kuching.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I invite the Honorable Sri Gading.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: If we look at the national security or public safety related to these police security personnel, it is important.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: However, we are sometimes surprised by the relevant news that was said to be mentally ill.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: So my question is, can we see it,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: because it involves family, colleagues.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: If we follow the number or list, from the year when the number is quite the most and during what month the stress is supposed to burden the police officers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: Second, is it because of the possible burdens
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: because the heavy task burden that causes the stress to be too high?
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: What are the initial reports steps that need to be made
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: and who is responsible for making this report to parties who are more responsible, more above.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]
addressees: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]

edus.text: Who is responsible in the police force.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: The responsible is the Department of Integrity and Standard Compliance.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: For now they have 109 counselors in Bukit Aman, in IPK and in IPD grade `` A '' where the OCPD is of ACP rank.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: We have 711 whom we call a Public Service Guiding Partner ( AKRAB ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Well, what factors contribute to this mental health disorder.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Study '' I don't want to take public studies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: I only take a study for the police.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: True, as Yang Berhormat Sri Gading mentioned the first stress factor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Second, health status.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Third, workplace environment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: So three main factors
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and when we zoom this, the results of the analysis were found that the stress factor was caused by him being disappointed in the relationship.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: He has problems in adapting in new settlements.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: He failed to control his self-responsibility.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: He is lonely as a result of being far from his family
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: and he has a marriage problem.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: All these factors contribute to stress.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: So, therefore, because this study found elements that contribute to this stress, sadness and anxiety, the entire step taken by the police force responsibly in the relevant section is to study from time to time the training module, intensify the existing programs, specifically for us, with permission, address the factors earlier accurately and granularly, not just random or catch fit.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: That is the priority we are implementing now.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail]
addressees: Tuan Haji Aminolhuda Hassan [Sri Gading]

edus.text: Can you have one more question?
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I invite the Honorable Mr. Tan Hong Pin, Bakri.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Tuan Tan Hong Pin ask the Minister of Health to state the latest status in the implementation of the Electronic Medical Record System ( EMR ) in hospitals and clinics across the country.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I would like to take this opportunity to congratulate you on continuing the Ramadan Kareem fasting service.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Speaker and also thank you to Yang Berhormat Bakri.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: For the digitization process in the hospital, the Informative System Hospital ( HIS ) is the main component of the administrative and clinical work process in the hospital.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: The implementation of the HIS @ KKM system in the KKM hospital is phased according to the project approved under the Rolling Plan of the Malaysia Plan ( RP RMK ), where the 11th RM RP4 has as many as seven hospitals in Negeri Sembilan will be involved through the National EMR Project.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: While for the 12th RM RP2, a total of seven more KKM hospitals across the country will be involved in the implementation of this HIS @ KKM system, this digitalization at the primary health care level, namely KK, has started since 2005 with the use of the TPC system and beyond, the TPC–OCHIS system in 2017 in health clinics and also dental clinics in an integrated manner.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: This system allows all patient care processes from registration
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: until the drug is implemented digitally
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: and patient records are stored electronically.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: This allows patient health records to be shared in any health clinic that uses the system I mentioned earlier, TPC–OCHIS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: The data in this system is also used for reporting for the purpose of planning the health program as well as supplying data to mobile applications as lifelong health records.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, until now we have 103 health clinics equipped with this TPC–OCHIS system and 42 health clinics in Negeri Sembilan will be equipped with the same system through the National EMR Project as I mentioned earlier.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: There are 1,027 health clinics that use online appointment systems through MySejahtera.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, 370 health clinics offer virtual clinic services ( virtual clinics ) to their customers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: The next plan is to expand, God willing, all related systems more comprehensively to achieve the objectives of an integrated health information system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, this EMR system is actually a good initiative, where it can integrate the information and history of a patient's illness.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I give an example, I am due to a career factor ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Go straight to the question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: I want to give a background so that the Honorable Minister can understand.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I went to Kluang Hospital, I filled out a form.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Then I moved to Johor Bahru Hospital, I had to repeat it and the doctor had to waste time asking about the history of my illness.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, to what extent - because I saw the Honorable Minister earlier saying that since 2005 we already have this system.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, to what extent can this system fully integrate?
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: What are the constraints and challenges faced causing until today I still see every hospital working in Silo.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Bakri.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Indeed, this is our dream.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Finally, one day, all patients can actually keep them with their own medical records.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: When they go to any clinic, they can release their data.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, actually to answer that, we- as many as this, only 27.5 percent of hospitals have a general patient management system and only 9.5 percent of health clinics, another 4.4 percent of dental clinics that have the system I mentioned earlier TPC - OCHIS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, our main challenge is actually to get or provide this comprehensive digitization, we need a very high budget, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: The budget can sometimes reach billions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, why is this implementation - what actually contributes to the high budget is
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: because it needs infrastructure upgrades.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, buildings also need to be suitable
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: if we want to use this digitization system, with its wiring and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Then, equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Sometimes our equipment is old equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, we have to upgrade the equipment by either repairing it
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: or we have to find a new one.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: That also contributes to the high budget needs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Of course, the others are the system itself, the system, then the cloud system and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, this is what sometimes means we also need of course, finally this complete implementation or the universal thing moving forward, we also need from the cooperation of the Ministry of Finance, God willing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We are confident that medical records or HIS can help reduce congestion in hospitals, especially in emergency units
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: and also in health clinics.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: However, it does not mean that
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: if there is a shortage of doctors and medical staff, they will not be able to accommodate a large number of patients.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, I would like to ask here.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: What is the justification when the Madani Government through the Public Service Department no longer sponsors any scholarships for critical fields such as medicine, pharmacy, dentistry and nursing?
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: We know that the cost of medicine is too high.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: We are confident that this will reduce the ability of the Malays to continue medical fields and in the long term will reduce the number of doctors from the Malay race.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Yes, I agree.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Actually, that's why I say that whatever problems we face in the ministry, it is not a problem that is only burdened
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: and burdened on the shoulders of the Malaysian Ministry of Health.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: It needs an integrated collaboration between JPA, also MOF, I also include it in our ecosystem for the preparation of the doctor,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: we also need to cooperate with the Ministry of Higher Education trained doctors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: So, I think that needs to be discussed thoroughly and I agree.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: God willing, I am concerned about this and we will look forward, what is the best thing we can implement to ensure that our ecosystem in this health service, especially doctors and also these health workers is taken seriously by all.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Honorable members, now the session for Minister's Question Time is over today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you. [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone
